programme.title: Giants in Green Bay
programme.desc: Mathew is joined by Cindy Braun the CEO of AMS Bowfishing as they travel to Green Bay Wisconsin in pursuit of giant common carp. Also known as Title Town USA home of the Green Bay Packers but also giant Carp. Also known for its world class Walleye fishing, these invasive carp must be kept in check as they destroy spawning habitat for the native fish. Non-stop bowfishing action as the Giants of Green Bay move into the shallows and make for some great night time bowfishing.

programme.title: East Coast Mixed Bag

programme.title: The Kids

The kids enjoy some daytime shooting and then get to experience bowfishing under the lights. The action heats up as some giant common carp get a free boat ride and the kids shoot their biggest fish to date.

programme.title: History of the AMS Big 20
programme.desc: Travel back in time with us this week as we relive the trials and tribulations that come with hosting one of the nation's biggest bowfishing tournaments. We navigate through the timeline of a tournament that started down in Brandenburg KY in 2011, with 40 boats participating, to a tournament that now regularly hosts 80+ boats up here in Wisconsin. The AMS Big 20 Challenge is now considered one of the premier events in the bowfishing world. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the roller coaster 13-year journey that has made the tournament what it is today.

Slamm'n Salmon, how cool is that.

programme.title: ECUADOR PART 1: THE FORGOTTEN FRONTIER
programme.desc:
Wildlife Photographer and Filmmaker Ian Breland heads into a remote region of the Ecuadorian Amazon situated between the lower-altitude Amazon Basin and the snowy, towering peaks of the Andes. Ian and the professionals he's with are in search of rare, undescribed, and iconic reptile & amphibian species; many of which are found nowhere else on Earth.
Despite being roughly the size of the state of Colorado, Ecuador harbors nearly 7% of the entire planet's biodiversity. This small but packed gem is currently the 17th most biodiverse country on the planet, though new discoveries and rediscoveries are rolling in every year- from plants, fish, and frogs to snakes and even mammals. The unique rainforests of Ecuador are equally as imperiled and silently exploited as they are exotic, and we must act now to both preserve and ethically appreciate what lies in the Forgotten Frontier.

programme.title: GUATEMALA PART II: LOST IN PERFECTION
programme.desc:
The guys are in the middle of their Central American expedition, now entrenched within the absurdly rich Caribbean jungles surrounded by cloud forests with diverse green valleys. They hike all day and night through the rainforest, searching for primarily Eyelash Vipers, Coral Snakes, and Jumping Pit Vipers.
The second the team arrives, they realize that the snake density is through the roof, and conditions are ideal. The first night yields tons of snakes, even one that no one can identify. It seems every nook and cranny has something beautiful, and they guys are almost as happily exhausted as they are stoked.

programme.title: PERUVIAN AMAZON PART 1: MOTHER OF GOD
programme.desc:
Madre De Dios translates to "Mother of God" in Spanish- a name more appropriate to none other than this region of Peru. Situated in the SW Amazon Basin, it remains one of the most understudied, inaccessible, and wild expanses of life on Earth. Unlike the area we explored in Ecuador, this part of the Amazon sits at a lower elevation- meaning that the more herpetologically favorable climate sustains an unfathomably elevated level of biodiversity.
Ian, Mike, and Sean (joined by their extra cameraman Tyler Velasquez) venture into protected territory alongside the snaking (and snakey) Las Piedras river in search of all things herps. The country is home to over 400 species (and counting) of reptiles alone, and the area is generally accepted as a world class Field Herping mecca.
The guys don't have any specific targets besides EVERYTHING, and waste no time jumping into the bush alongside a myriad of resident naturalists and friends to see what can be uncovered.

programme.title: ECUADOR PART II: EXPLORING THE UNDISCOVERED
programme.desc:
Wildlife Photographer and Filmmaker Ian Breland is back in a remote region of the Ecuadorian Amazon- situated between the lower-altitude Amazon Basin and the snowy, towering peaks of the Andes. Ian and the professionals he's with are in search of rare, undescribed, and iconic reptile & amphibian species; many of which are found nowhere else on Earth.
This time though, they're searching specifically for some incredible frog, toad, and salamander species. What they uncover is nothing short of mesmerizing.
Despite being roughly the size of the state of Colorado, Ecuador harbors nearly 7% of the entire planet's biodiversity. This small but packed gem is currently the 17th most biodiverse country on the planet, though new discoveries and rediscoveries are rolling in every year- from plants, fish, and frogs to snakes and even mammals. The unique rainforests of Ecuador are equally as imperiled and silently exploited as they are exotic, and we must act now to both preserve and ethically appreciate what lies in the Forgotten Frontier.

programme.title: PERUVIAN AMAZON PART II: DON'T LOSE THE FOREST THROUGH THE TREES
programme.desc:
Still in the Amazon, the team is rolling from one encounter to the next. Each find lights their eyes up like fireworks and keeps everyone pushing forward. With only a week left to experience pure bliss, it's all hands on deck for the better part of 24 hours a day. The final find though- no one imagined it would be so sweet.
While a quick dip into the largest rainforest on Earth may render one to conjure thoughts of their surroundings being immortal and indestructible- the truth is a sobering one. Roughly 1,100 square miles of Peru's forests are cut down every year—around 80% of them illegally. Fires burn where they shouldn't, uncontacted indigenous are pushed out of their homes, the sun gazes hotter, the rains hit harder. The main culprits of deforestation are small-scale agriculture, commercial mining and related road construction, and forest degradation is caused primarily by illegal logging.
The scars across Peru are visible from space, and if we can't sustainably progress while keeping love at the forefront of our decisions- the necessary prescription for biodiversity is annihilation.

programme.title: COLORADO: SUBTERRANEAN WONDERS
programme.desc:
Ian, Sean, and Mike's search for reptiles and amphibians lands them in an astoundingly rich haven which also happens to be the most threatened ecosystem on earth: Prairie Grasslands.
The nearly destroyed grasslands of Eastern Colorado may not seem like much to your average mall crawler, but if one just looks a little bit closer- you'll spot a wonderland unlike any other. Some of the planet's most striking snakes fill the caverns beneath your feet, with impressively venomous vipers blessing the ground you traverse.
The team wanders hours on end through grassy plains, flipping debris for a shot at revealing a glimpse into the world witnessed by few and appreciated by all find it.

programme.title: GUATEMALA PART III: VALLEY OF DRAGONS
programme.desc:
Nearing the end of their Guatemala expedition, the team has one final (and impatiently awaited) location- the driest region in all of Central America, Motagua Valley. The valley resembles the boys' home, Arizona in uncanny ways- though it's uniqueness is unmatched.
The dry, shrubby hillsides are home to one of the planet's most critically endangered endemic species, the venomous Guatemalan Beaded Lizard. The group stays on a reserve (Reserva Natural Heloderma) in the last remaining fragments of the valley's ecosystem, and catch an incredible opportunity to see the lizards up close and help in the vital process of rewilding them in hopes that the population may stabilize.
They're also searching for a lifelong dream, the Central American Rattlesnake. The snake is almost more of a dragonesque creature than our lizard friends, and certainly a more imposing one.
The team expects hunting the rattlesnakes down to become a major struggle; yet they discover that despite massive habitat degradation and human impact, the valley is far more dense in reptilian concentration than anyone had anticipated.
There is still so much left to see- and save.

programme.title: GUATEMALA PART 1: GUARDIANS OF THE CLOUD FOREST
programme.desc:
Guatemala sits in a Neotropical transitional area that connects South America to North America, through a narrowly winding stream of land with varying altitudes and landscapes that we've come to call Central America.
Ian, Mike, and Trent link up with Wildlife Photographer Andres Novales to travel across the country, targeting the different legendary and threatened species in each region. First, they tackle the prehistoric cloud forests, high altitude mountainous jungles that have fostered the evolution of many different venomous tree-dwelling pit vipers. The biggest targets here are the Yellow-blotched Palm Pit Viper and the Guatemalan Palm Pit Viper.
Stumbling through year's worth of decaying plant matter and vibrant palms towering over the group, they hike into unknown territory with big plans.

programme.title: CALIFORNIA: LAVA MONSTERS
programme.desc:
The gang continues on their road trip through the seemingly endless Sonoran Desert, seeking out deeply remote and arid regions. They head to a stunningly dry and convincingly sparse mountain range nested near the Mexico border in search of the esteemed white-phase Speckled Rattlesnake; soon moving on into Southern California.
The guys meet up with fellow herper, History Channel show host, and good friend Rob Alleva to track down a snake some in the group have only seen photos of- though none of them could have foreseen what they end up running into.
The final, and arguably most incredible pit stop of the trip is an ancient volcanic lava field. Here lies the main target of their 2-week blitz, the "lava-phase Speckled Rattlesnake". Harboring a nearly black color scheme known only from this specific area due to some fast paced evolution, these jaw dropping animals sometimes prove to be almost as hard to track down as they are pleasing to the eye.

This one is another example of how always being ready can make or break getting a shot and Chad does just that! Upon walking up on his gobbler, Chad spots a curved spur kicking off a great start to the '24 hunting season.

programme.title: Bass Fishing with a Simple Walmart Bass Fishing Rod, Reel and Tackle Setup
programme.desc:
Need a quick and easy bass rod and reel setup? So did I! While out of town in Moultrie, Georgia for business, I forgot my bass rod and tackle at home, so I ran to the local Walmart and bought just what I needed for a great price. Walk with me as I pick out which bass fishing rod I prefer and why, than the lures I think would work best for bass while here in Moultrie, Georgia.
After purchasing my bass fishing rod and bass tackle from Walmart for a great price, I head on over to a local pond near the hotel I am staying at in Moultrie, Georgia. I than set up my new Lew's Speed Stick rod by attaching the Abu Garcia reel I bought to it. Then I string my Spiderwire braided fishing line through my new pole and attach some 20 pound mono to the end. After that I tie a size 3/0 Mustad offset hook to my line, put on split slide weights, and I am ready for the lure! I bought two different types of rubber worms. Purple Powerbaits and Watermelon Yum Dingers.
I am ready to catch some bass! On Day 1, I used the Watermelon worms and caught three gorgeous Georgia Bass! On Day 2 I tried to switch up to the purple and didn't get a single hit. Switched back to the Watermelon worms and caught a bass almost instantly!

programme.title: Hunting the Rut in Mississippi - Part 1
programme.desc:
Hunting the Rut in Mississippi - Part 1
Husband and wife team, Reese & Amber Richards (owners of Bearded Outdoors) go on their first ever out of state hunt together to north Mississippi on the quest to harvest Amber's first buck ever! This is a two part series, so be sure you're following Bearded Outdoors so you don't miss Part 2!
"We were invited by the owners of Conviction Outdoors to come hunt their gorgeous rolling hills on almost 200 acres of private family land. They stayed in the cabin on the property as well which was hand built by the owner himself. Absolutely gorgeous! We were so blessed to have had this opportunity and we enjoyed the property, food, and fellowship very much! To have been invited back was icing on the cake!"

programme.title: 200 Disabled Veterans go Deep Sea Fishing in the Gulf!
programme.desc:
We were invited by Iron Men Outdoor Ministries to attend their Annual Deep Sea Fishing with Disabled Veterans trip. These two days consisted of a banquet to raise money and honor all of the disabled veterans that were invited on the fishing trip, as well as a day on the water, deep sea fishing on several boats!
There ended up being 200 disabled veterans fishing! There were 20 total boats that took these men and women fishing! Three of these boats were 90 foot fishing charter vessels, and the rest were smaller charter boats. The total number of fish caught exceeded 2000! The total number of fish kept was about 1600!
This entire trip was amazing to say the least! Being asked to film and collect content of what it is that Iron Men Ministries does, as well as to capture these disabled vets having a blast catching fish, was such an honor and so humbling! We are already counting down the days till the next one!
Here are all the ways to connect with Iron Men Outdoors: Website: https://www.ironmenoutdoorministries.com/ Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/IMOM2013 Festus Potee: https://www.facebook.com/festus.potee

programme.title: Sight Unseen
programme.desc:
In the premiere episode of Modern Homestead, Janna Breslin and Evan DeMarco take the plunge into a world they've never known before, as they embark on a journey that promises to challenge their limits, expand their horizons, and redefine their very notions of homesteading. What begins as a bold venture to buy 120 acres in the picturesque Tennessee landscape quickly transforms into an eye-opening experience that neither of them could have anticipated.
The episode kicks off with excitement and a sense of adventure as Janna and Evan, an unlikely pair consisting of a cover model and a scientist, reveal their audacious plan to create a thriving homestead capable of withstanding even the most unexpected challenges - including a potential zombie apocalypse. Armed with enthusiasm and a determination to master the art of self-sufficiency, they set out to build their dream oasis where they will source their own water, grow their own food, generate energy, and construct their own shelter.
However, as the saying goes, reality often has other plans. What Janna and Evan initially perceive as a straightforward path to their modern homesteading vision takes an unexpected turn. As they explore their new purchase, they encounter challenges that leave them both baffled and humbled. The land they imagined to be a canvas of endless possibilities presents them with a unique set of obstacles they hadn't foreseen.
Amidst the breathtaking beauty of the Tennessee landscape, the duo faces unexpected revelations. The landscape itself is both enchanting and unpredictable, with its own stories etched into every rock and tree. With each twist and turn, Janna and Evan's perceptions of their journey shift, and they find themselves relying on each other's strengths more than ever before.
As they dive deeper into their new reality, the couple discovers that their homesteading adventure is about more than just mastering survival skills; it's about embracing the unknown, learning from failures, and celebrating triumphs no matter how small. The episode captures the candid moments of frustration, laughter, and perseverance as they navigate through the challenges of homesteading.

programme.title: Chili Bathroom
programme.desc:
In the second episode of The Modern Homestead, Janna and Evan's journey gets off to a chaotic start when Janna wakes up with something very dangerous in her hair.
With Janna's hair emergency as a wake-up call, Evan swings into action and calls in the experts. They bring in a food security systems designer and a homesteading expert to help them navigate the complexities of their new life.
Simultaneously, the couple recognizes the pressing need to transform their cabin into a more safe, functional and comfortable space. This includes building a much-needed bathroom for those moments when Evan has a bit too much chili.
Episode two brings laughs, excitement and and the recognition that building the Modern Homestead might not be as easy as they thought,

programme.title: Breaking The Mold
programme.desc: In this episode of Modern Homestead, Janna and Evan start their cabin renovation but discover what they think is black mold. While awaiting a contractor, they visit a Florida homestead for an education on growing food.

programme.title: Water of Love
programme.desc: Janna and Evan address the water issues on The Modern Homestead. After attempting to fix the leaking ponds and address the well water problem, they take a trip to South Carolina to learn about some amazing technology that ensures they will always have water.

programme.title: Baa Baa
programme.desc: Janna and Evan catch an early flight from back from California to begin working on the greenhouse. Janna's lofty ideas for the green house, which include a full bar, put the project well over budget and way behind schedule. They turn to repurposing materials from an old hoop house Butch found in a field. Janna gets distracted by baby goats.

programme.title: Boats and Hoops
programme.desc:
After days filled with construction challenges, cabin renovations, and a daunting hoop house project, Janna and Evan decide it's time to unwind and recharge. Evan surprises Janna with a getaway to beautiful Lake Norris in Tennessee, hoping to enjoy a relaxing weekend away from the homestead.
With a speed boat and an innertube, relaxing is the last thing happens. Janna loses her top, her bottoms, her Whoop and her hair tie all in one run on the tube before learning to waterski.
Amid the chaos and wardrobe malfunctions, the couple finds joy in shared laughter and unexpected adventures, proving that even in the midst of homesteading challenges, the most treasured moments are often the ones unplanned and full of laughter.

programme.title: Func Shui
programme.desc: Evan has one last surprise up his sleeve for Janna before their return from a relaxing trip to the lake. It's llamas! They visit a llama farm, then return to find Jeff brought a construction crew for cabin renovations. The arrival of the construction crew adds a new layer of excitement to the homestead's transformation. Together with the construction crew, they begin to see their dream home taking shape in ways they never imagined.Evan invents a new design technique.

programme.title: Talk Dirty to Me
programme.desc:
In this episode of Modern Homestead, the challenges keep piling up for the Janna and Evan. The cabin, once a symbol of their dreams, is under siege from nature itself. As they open up the walls for much-needed renovations, they discover an alarming infestation of black mold. But that's not all; the back wall of the cabin has been entirely consumed by termites and carpenter ants, presenting a threat to the entire structure.
Jeff takes on the daunting task of tackling these issues, while Janna and Evan shift their focus to building the gardens, preparing for the upcoming planting season. Evan gives a crash course in the science and art of soil.
The episode also features a cozy fireside chat, where Butch and Jeff pick up their guitars for a special "Modern Homestead Unplugged" acoustic set.
In "Talk Dirty to Me," the homesteaders are reminded that a homestead is more than just a house; it's a living, breathing project that requires their unwavering dedication and resourcefulness.

programme.title: Creeping Thyme
programme.desc: Janna and Evan continue to face challenges with the inside of the cabin but are able to get the outside corked using a new building material. Friends and family show up to help with the outside gardens, getting them closer to food security.

programme.title: Guns, Bows and BigFoot
programme.desc: With termite damage causing significant setbacks in their cabin renovation, Janna and Evan decide to channel their frustrations into a friendly yet competitive shooting and archery contest. This episode not only showcases their skills but also addresses the importance of security on the homestead from both a technical and practical standpoint. Amidst the competition, with a special prize for the winner, they also encounter a surprise introduction to a potentially influential neighbor on their property, adding an intriguing twist to their journey.

programme.title: Domestead
programme.desc: In the season 1 finale, Janna and Evan provide an intimate and heartfelt recap of their first year in off-grid living, a journey filled with both triumphs and trials. This episode stands as a milestone, marking the completion of their 30-foot dome, a significant achievement that allows them to finally sleep on their homestead.

programme.title: Detroit River Walleyes
programme.desc: Join Curtis M. Creech and Paul Laurain as they capitalize on Lake Erie's largest Walleye migration into the Detroit River. The Spring Walleye Run in Detroit is absolutely epic and you won't want to miss this non-stop action of some total hog walleyes in this episode of Michigan Fishing Nation TV!

programme.title: Spring Walleye Jigging
programme.desc: Join Curtis, Melanie, Diana, Andrew and Paul for some Spring Walleye jigging action on the St. Clair River in Port Huron, Michigan! Jigging is when you catch walleye in the rivers using an up and down motion while simultaneously using your trolling motor to stay vertical while navigating through the current. It's one of the most challenging ways to fish. You won't wanna miss these awesome fish!

programme.title: Lake Huron Walleyes
programme.desc: Join Curtis, Wife Melanie, their boys Aiden and Colton, along with Uncle Adam, as they travel to Fort Gratiot, Michigan, to get after some Great Lakes Walleyes on Lake Huron. This area and episode really showcases the beauty of Michigan's Great Lakes, you won't wanna miss this! Thanks for tuning in to Michigan Fishing Nation TV.

programme.title: St. Clair River Sturgeon Fishing
programme.desc: Join Curtis, Mel and Paul as they target Michigan's oldest Prehistoric Fish in Algonac, Michigan, the mighty Sturgeon! Imagine hooking into a freshwater shark and nearly snapping your rod in half during the fight! Dive below the depths of the St. Clair River at night with Curtis and the gang! You will not want to miss this action packed episode of Michigan Fishing Nation TV.

programme.title: Smallmouth Bass Fishing
programme.desc: Join Curtis as he tries Kayak Fishing for the first time near Michigan's Hidden Gem, "Turnip Rock" in search of some Smallmouth gold! Once they start casting, you will not believe the non-stop Lake Huron Smallmouth Bass action! This is a trip for the record books that you will not want to miss.

programme.title: River Trolling & Whipping for Walleyes
programme.desc: Join Curtis, wife Melanie, Brother-in-law Adam and Father-in-law Fred for an amazing episode on Michigan's St. Clair River from Marysville as they troll down the river for Walleye during the day and transition to the local tactic of "whipping" at night! By the end of this episode, you'll have everything you need to start cracking that whip and have a boat-load of walleyes!

programme.title: Motor City Walleye Jigging
programme.desc: Join Curtis, Melanie and Paul as they venture across the Detroit River between Michigan and Canada (Ontario) in search of some icy cold Walleyes for the fryer! This is the video you'll want to watch to learn how you can get on the river and jig up some tasty walleyes!

programme.title: How to Jig for Michigan Walleyes
programme.desc: Join Curtis, Adam and Paul as they scout for Walleye near the Blue Water Bridge in Port Huron Michigan and Sarnia in Ontario, Canada. This is a great how-to video on jigging for river walleyes.

programme.title: Winter Walleye Jigging
programme.desc: Curtis and Paul venture out between Michigan and Canadian waters of Ontario in search of some tasty Winter Walleye on the St. Clair River.

programme.title: Walleye Jigging Mayhem 2025
programme.desc: Curtis, Adam and Andrew venture out into the icy St. Clair River to pull in some hog walleyes!

programme.title: Hawaii Wild Boar And Spearfishing
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads to the island of Maui to hunt for wild pigs and do some spearfishing. You won't believe the double shot Kyle makes on pigs!

programme.title: Alaska Sockeye Salmon
programme.desc: Kyle Green heads to Alaska to fish for sockeye salmon with his cousin William, and buddy Mike. They catch limits every day and enjoy the most beautiful scenery in the world!

programme.title: High Mountain Chukar
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads to the mountains in Eastern Washington to target chukar. This frustrating upland bird makes for a great adventure!

programme.title: Channel Islands Fishing
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads out to the Channel Islands National Park 30 miles offshore to fish for halibut and whitefish. The amount of fish they see while spearfishing is incredible!

programme.title: Hawaii Axis Deer
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads to the island of Maui to hunt Axis Deer! Jeff gets a giant buck and Kyle embarks on an unforgettable journey.

programme.title: Snake River Cutthroat
programme.desc: Kyle Green heads to the Snake River in Idaho to fish for rainbow trout and work with the DNR to help save the cutthroat trout. The management of this fishery is a touchy subject, but the team follows the science to get real answers!

programme.title: The Great Washington Bird Hunt
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads to Washington State to hunt for ducks and quail. Lots of birds and lots of laughs in this high-action episode!

programme.title: Inland Lake Ice Fishing
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team targets northern pike through the ice with their buddy Scott Slater. The big one they catch is a beauty!

programme.title: Noodling Giant Catfish
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team heads down to Texas to try their hand at noodling. Did they catch a new Texas state record blue cat?

programme.title: Manistee River King Salmon
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors heads to the Manistee River in Northern Michigan to target King Salmon! Jeff catches an absolute monster!

programme.title: Prehistoric Paddlefish
programme.desc: Kyle Green travels to Oklahoma to fish for a prehistoric dinosaur called the paddlefish. He never expected the action to be this good!

programme.title: Giant Lake Sturgeon
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors team head out on the St Clair river to target giant lake sturgeon with their buddy Mitch. The monster Kyle caught was way over the slot limit!

programme.title: The Florida Kingfish
programme.desc: Kyle Green travels to Florida with his Sea-Doo FishPro Trophy to target kingfish, snook and giant Tarpon! He meets up with Frank Viola and Bri Andrassy who take Kyle out of his freshwater comfort zone. They go 7 miles out to sea, fish under docks, and everything in between. Don't miss the biggest fish we have ever featured on our show!

programme.title: THE MAINE MOOSE
programme.desc: The chances of getting drawn for moose tag in the state of Maine is slim to none. However, since the winter tick problem has been getting so bad in moose populations the department of fish and game has had to open up more opportunity for hunters to kill these ticks with moose hunting. How does that work?

programme.title: ALAKSA SOCKEYE SALMON
programme.desc: The last frontier is not a place for the faint of heart. It's full of natural resources that can harvested if you're willing to go on an adventure for it! Kyle and his cousin, William, go out for the sought after, sockeye salmon. Kyle is learning a new method of fishing that could be frowned upon if practiced in other places of North America. This method is called flossing.

programme.title: THE SNAKEHEAD FISH
programme.desc: A fish that heals you? Many cultures believe that the snakehead fish has healing capabilities that can even cure cancer. That is part of the reason why this invasive species ended up in the North American waterways. Kyle and Jeff visit Maryland to understand how the locals have turned this invasive species into a positive!

programme.title: THE MYSTERIOUS 10,000 ISLANDS
programme.desc: What do Native Americans, Pirates and Drug Smugglers all have in common? The 10,000 Islands of South West Florida. Kyle heads out on an adventure to see if he can catch, cook, camp and learn a few things about these mysterious chain of islands that many before him had somehow survived on.

programme.title: REMOTE LAKE ICE FISHING
programme.desc: What snowmobiles and Trout have in common? They both have thriving populations in Idaho. Kyle meets up with Idaho biologist, Bret High. Bret takes Kyle deep into the mountains of Idaho to see how well the trout are doing in the remote lakes that were previously stocked by Idaho fish and game.

programme.title: THE TEXAS GATOR HUNT
programme.desc:
Snakes, rotten chicken, gators, and Texas Heat. Kyle, Jeff and Ryan visit their buddy in Texas to harvest these prehistoric lizards.
Only one problem, Kyle and Jeff made a bet...

programme.title: BISON BISON BISON
programme.desc: The Green Way Outdoors heads to Oklahoma to learn a history lesson about the North American Bison.

programme.title: UPPER PENNISULA TROUT ADVENTURES
programme.desc: Kyle, Jeff and their friend, Scott, spend some time in their home state. They visit places that were surrounds with Native American legends, giant cliffs and of course some trout fishing.

programme.title: INVASIVE CARP DISASTER
programme.desc: Kyle heads to South Dakota to see for himself how bad the invasive asian carp problem is. With the help of his friend Erin "Chummy" Riibe, they head out onto the water to blowfish for these invasive fish.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #1 - Robbie Kroger "In the Blood"
programme.desc: What is Blood Origins? Robbie Kroger tells us about his philosophy on what Blood Origins means and relates it to his story. A South African native, he has come to the United States and is looking to his past to learn more about what hunting meant to him and his family for generations.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #2 - Keith Polk & Lake Pickle "Threaded"
programme.desc: Everyone has a story… For Lake & Keith, it is one of mentorship, lifelong friendship, and a passion for sharing their love of hunting with younger generations. Through a program bringing the hunting experience to younger generations, they came to know more about their love of the outdoors and being a role model. The tradition then lived on through their experiences like many other traditions in the hunting community.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #3 - Ryan "Koup" Kuperus "Giants"
programme.desc: Ryan "Koup" Kuperus is a retired USMC Gunnery Sergeant. After a devastating Humvee rollover accident, his femur and back were both broken. The nature of his accident and experiences overseas left him searching for answers on how to adjust to life at home. The outdoors and hunting provided him with an escape. Now, he works on engaging other veterans and people going through experiences like his to hunting and the outdoors. Using the experiences of nature and hunting traditions, he works to give others the healing he found in the peacefulness of the wilderness.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #4 - Craig Corsi "Giants"
programme.desc: Craig Corsi lives the hunting life dedicated to the outdoors. A retired USMC 1st Sergeant, the path Corsi has chosen for himself is based on the tenants of family, hunting, and dedication to the outdoors. Through his business and lifestyle, he can invest in others and bring more experiences to those around him looking to understand the hunting tradition.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #5 - Cuz Strickland "Heart"
programme.desc: As one of the originators, Cuz Strickland has the insight to tell a story more rooted in hunting and tradition than most. He was focused from experiences at a young age on how hunting and humanity came together. He aims to always make that experience available to young people. He wants the hunters of tomorrow to see the outdoors and love of the forests from a lense of understanding and respect.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #8 - Leonard Bentz "Fathers"
programme.desc: Your story is likely unique to you, just as my own story is probably unlike yours.

programme.title: Blood Origins Episode #12 - Derek Harris "Memories"
programme.desc: From an early age Derek was raised to be a different breed of hunter. It wasn't all about the kill. His dad instilled in him that being outdoors is an experience. Being outdoors is about making memories and relationships with others. He would take these same values and instill them into his little brother. As he matured Derek took this one step further, by becoming a professional outfitter in New Mexico, and took it as a profession to take others hunting and into the outdoors to make their own memories

programme.title: How to Bowfish
programme.desc: The Barbed Team teaches you the ins and outs of sticking fish

programme.title: Common Carp
programme.desc: Learn all about the Common carp, and why its so important to help control;l the numbers in the lakes rivers and streams

programme.title: Buffalo Fish
programme.desc: learn all about Buffalo Fish, also known as Buffalo carp. How to find them, where to find them, and when to find them in specific areas

programme.title: Showing Silvers
programme.desc: Learn techniques on bowfishing for Silver Carp

programme.title: Bowfishing Cownose Rays
programme.desc: The team explains some tactics, tips and strategies on bowfishing for Cownose rays

programme.title: Michigan Pope and Young Bow Hunt
programme.desc: Derek Proulx takes us on his 2022 bow season and capitalizes on a beautiful Michigan 10 point with his bow.

programme.title: First Time Turkey Hunters
programme.desc: Derek Proulx and Jeremiah Saier take their kids, Gemma and Easton, out turkey hunting in search for their first Michigan longbeards.

programme.title: Soque Trout
programme.desc: The north Georgia mountains have some of the best trout fishing in the US. Capt. Cefus McRae fishes the fabled Soque River with Unicoi Outfitters for trophy rainbow trout.

programme.title: AirBoat Trout
programme.desc: Capt. Cefus McRae and Capt. John Wells explore the skinny water backcountry of Florida 's Big Bend targeting speckled trout and redfish on a windy day. They fish waters only accessible by an air boat.

programme.title: Fishing Adventures Florida
programme.desc: Capt. Sergio, Capt. George is joined with Capt. Brian Goldman in search of shallow water redfish in upper Tampa Bay. Extreme low tides the captains wor hard but it paid off

programme.title: Fishing Adventures Florida
programme.desc: The Captains with the help of Capt. Michael Dawson search for snook around the out islands. Fighting high winds and falling tide made it difficult fishing but at the end of the day some new techniques made it happen

programme.title: Lake Poygan Walleyes
programme.desc: This week on Larry Smith Outdoors we hit Lake Poygan for a two day Walleye bite. We brought Terry from BiteMeBox and I even had two of my kids (Isaac, Sawyer, and his Girlfriend Jen) out on the lake. Unbelievable Walleye bite for beginnings of new ICE! Check out the motherload of fish we caught!

programme.title: How to catch Crappies on Basin lakes Ice fishing
programme.desc: LEARN how to catch more basin crappies ice fishing! On this week's episode we head over to Chippewa county to hook up with Andrew from Backroads Guide Service! Andrew has been a long time friend of the show and an awesome fishing guide! He puts us on a great basin crappie bites and shows us some great tips on how you can catch more!

programme.title: Larry's BIGGEST BUCK! (Minnesota Muzzleloader Hunt)
programme.desc: On this weeks episode we head over to Minnesota for a muzzleloader deer hunt! Larry is in the right place at the right time and shoots his biggest buck ever!

programme.title: Ice Fishing BIG Green Bay Perch
programme.desc: On this week's episode we head up the West shore of Green Bay to fish GIANT perch with Bite Me Box Tip Ups! The bite was on and the fish were BIG!

programme.title: 7 Muskies in the Boat (Ashland GIANTS)
programme.desc: Fall is a great time to catch muskies because they are starting to feed heavy before the cold. With water temperatures dropping, we joined up with Dave Brown from Bait Rigs and Mike Mollo to try and put some muskies in the boat.

programme.title: Locating and Catching Northern Wisconsin Panfish
programme.desc: We hit the ice with Jeff Van Remortel for Crappies and Walleye. We definitely had our work cut out for us but overall a very successful day!

programme.title: Squirrel Hunting (Catch-Clean-Cook)
programme.desc: On this week's episode we go chase some squirrels! Squirrel hunting is one of Larry's favorite sports and the local farmer want his woods cleared of em'!

programme.title: Personal Best Smallmouth for Larry
programme.desc:
On this week's episode we headed up to Sturgeon Bay to hook up with Lonney Goman to go after some monster and I mean MONSTER smallmouth bass!
I get lucky enough to hook up with my PB biggest bass

programme.title: Night Trolling Techniques for Walleyes (BIG WATER)
programme.desc: On this week's episode we head for Sturgeon Bay to team up with two amazing guides, Lonney Goman of Green Bay Trophy Fishing and Brett Alexander of Alexander Sport Fishing. These 2 guys have an amazing trolling night bite on Sturgeon Bay for some great walleyes and would love to shoe you some tips of how to catch more!

programme.title: CRAZY Grouse Hunt (ACTION 30 Flushes)
programme.desc:
On this week's episode we head up to the northwoods of Wisconsin to go grouse hunting! Teaming up with some amazing grouse hunters from Tennessee, we get in on some HOT grouse action!
What is your favorite grouse recipe?

programme.title: Chewamegon Bay Diver Ducks
programme.desc: On this week's episode we head north to Lake Superior to hunt diver ducks with Tommy Hicks from Beyond the Catch Guide Service!

programme.title: Walleye Fishing the Castle Rock Flowage
programme.desc: This week were out walleye fishing with our good buddy Shotgun Shafer and Mike from Mike's Country Meats. We also solve the toilet paper crisis.

programme.title: Menomonee SmallMouth with Clairmont
programme.desc: This Week we meet up with our buddy Brian Clairmont! We're fishing some smallmouth and were hoping for a MONSTER. See if we find 'em!

programme.title: Apostle Island Trout Fishing
programme.desc: On this week's episode we head up to one of my favorite spots, the APOSTLE ISLANDS! We team up with Tommy Hicks and chase splake and brown trout!!! Hold on, it's gonna be a wild ride!

programme.title: Lake Trout on Superior with Tommy Hicks
programme.desc:
There's nothing better than jigging up lake trout, especially out of Lake Superior! Join us as we head up to Ashland to fish with the one and only Tommy Hicks of Beyond the Catch! Phil the Blind Guy joins us and Tommy's lovely wife Mackenzie! We go out and fish for whitefish in the morning and the wind blew us off, then we went out to the Apostle Islands and jig for lakers!
#bigfish #laketroutfishing #howtocatchlaketrout

programme.title: How to Catch GIANT Summer Walleyes
programme.desc:
On this week's episode we head up to Green Bay for some exceptional walleye fishing! We target these fish jigging and trolling and break down some simple tips and tricks so you can learn how to catch giant summer walleyes!
#walleyefishing #walleye #howtocatchwalleyes

programme.title: Sturgeon Bay SmallMouth
programme.desc: On this week's episode we headed up to Door County to fish for some GIANT summer smallmouth bass! Sturgeon Bay is know for their exceptional smallie fishing and amazing views! We used a variety of techniques such as paddletails, tube jigs and ned rigs to target these fish. Tune in for tips on location and lures to put more bass in your boat!

programme.title: Walleye Fishing (MONSTER) with Jeff Van Remortel
programme.desc: On this week's show we headed up to Minocqua to visit our good friend and guide Jeff Vanremortel! Jeff is extremely dialed into the fishing up here and always puts us on a great bite. With some of the ice coming off of the lakes days or hours before we were getting into some post spawn walleyes and they were munchin! Simple set ups with a jig and minnow were all we needed to put a pile in the boat!

programme.title: Backwater Blue Gills on the Mississippi
programme.desc: On this week's episode we headed back over to fish the mighty Mississippi River! We had some crazy warm weather and it opened up the river so we had to take a flat bottom boat onto the ice to get on the fish! When we got on the fish, we smoked em! Huge gills and jumbo perch were on the menu that day and we couldn't get enough!

programme.title: Turkey Hunting (Exciting Turkey Hunt)
programme.desc: This year we can't get enough turkey hunting! We asked our good friends from Warrior Boats, Kent and Jacob Andersen to join us in turkey camp! First we started out with Lucy and had some awesome action, we had 3 birds come in and start beating up the half strut jake decoy! 15 minutes later we finally got a good shot and Lucy capitalized! We headed out to the same blind in the morning with Kent and Jacob and had 2 more big toms come in to beat up our decoy!

programme.title: Fishing Madison Perch with BIG B! (MONSTER PERCH)
programme.desc: This Week on Larry Smith Outdoors we make a trip down to Madison to hook up with our friend Brian Zupke! We put the smack down on these huge perch! Definitely the place to be if you're looking to find some OVER average perch!

programme.title: Whitefishing with Our Sponsors
programme.desc: This week we take our sponsors out white fishing in Green Bay to thank them for their support throughout the year! We definitely put the smackdown on these fish!

programme.title: Northern Wisconsin WHITEFISH! (how to ice fish)
programme.desc: On this week's episode we head up to Minocqua by our good friend Jeff Van Remortel to fish for northern Wisconsin Whitefish! After doing a number on the whitefish we target a few late afternoon walleyes!

programme.title: Iowa Perch and Yellow Bass (Spawning eelpout)
programme.desc: On this episode we head over to Ruthsben, Iowa to fish with Legends Guide Service for perch, yellow bass and walleyes! The conditions were a little nasty and the cold front had the fish somewhat shut down but we still had an amazing day! Eelpout are one of the best eating fish in the lakes and put up one heck of a fight!!! Tune in as Larry shows you how he catches, clean, and cooks eelpout!

programme.title: Late Ice MONSTER Pike Fishing
programme.desc: On this week's episode we head up to the bay of Green Bay to chase late ice MONSTER pike! With pike moving into shallow bays and getting ready to spawn we set a monster spread of tip ups in hopes for GIANT! Good friends, good times and lots of laughs on this awesome day!

programme.title: KILLER Crappie Bite
programme.desc: This week on Larry Smith Outdoors.. While Larry was on the farm planting trees we got a call from our friend Brian Zupke of Big B's Guide service and he was on a killer crappie bite! Hold onto your Hineys because Brian and Caleb are DIALED IN!

programme.title: INSANE Tarpon Fishing!!!
programme.desc:
On this week's episode we hopped on an airplane down to Marco Island to chase the king of fish, Tarpon! Guided by Dave Nelson of Lifetime Fishing Outfitters we had the experience of a lifetime!!!
Dave is one of the most knowledgable and hard working guides we've ever fished with. No doubt he is the person you want to go with if you want to chase these fish!

programme.title: How to Catch and Clean BULLHEADS
programme.desc: On this week's episode we got a call from our good friend Terry to go fish for some bullheads! When I was a kid i use to fish for bullheads with my dad all the time! They are relatively easy to catch, easy to clean and great to eat! Check it out as I show how to catch, clean and cook some bullheads!

programme.title: Coyote Hunting with THERMAL SCOPES
programme.desc: Coyotes are some of the smartest and most cunning animals you can hunt! Their amazing eyes, eyes and sense of smell can usually keep them safe. However, we decided to upgrade our arsenal with a little help from thermal scopes and infrared scopes. Check out as we do a little population control on our local coyotes!

programme.title: FIshing for Walleyes on a RAFT
programme.desc:
On this week's episode we join our good friend Kurt Duxbury on the Wolf River on his fishing raft! Many locals love this tradition and they can be extremely successful at helping you bag your limit of fish on the Wolf River!
Using cane poles and Wolf River rigs with fatheads and shiners we were able to put some nice fish on the raft!

programme.title: Little Girl Shoots First Turkey with CROSSBOW
programme.desc: On this week's episode, we joined 3 youth hunters on the Wisconsin youth turkey hunt! Two of the three girls had some luck and an unforgettable experience! The youth turkey hunt is an awesome opportunity to have kids get a good chance at a turkey before everyone else and these girls closed the deal!

programme.title: Trolling for Post Spawn Walleyes Tips+Tricks
programme.desc: Then we head out with Lightning Lance and Brian Clairmont for some night trolling for walleyes! They break down some tips and tricks for you to catch some more fish!

programme.title: Crappie Fishing Beaver Dam (HUNTING GIANTS)
programme.desc: This week on Larry Smith Outdoors we hook up with our friends Pete Hupf and Steve Draginis to hunt some HUGE Crappies on Beaver Dam! Stay tuned to see what we find!!

programme.title: Panfishing in Chippewa County
programme.desc:
On this week's episode, we head up to Chippewa County to fish with Tom and Jackie and we had one heck of a time! Fishing the Holcombe Flowage we traveled up and down and found an awesome school of bluegills!
Then we get hooked up with our friends at Wings Over Wisconsin for their youth fishing event! They teach the kids about fishing techniques, fish cleaning, and invasive species!

programme.title: Catching GIANT Spawning Bluegills
programme.desc: On this week's episode we head down to Madison, Wisconsin to fish with the one and only Big B's Guide Service! Brian is a bluegill master and has a spot all picked out for us! Locating the beds using side imaging and good polarized glasses we put the smackdown on the gills! Remembering good catch and release ethics is EXTREMELY important for spawning bluegills to protect the population and future genetics for years to come!

programme.title: SIGHT FISHING Crappies with Jeff VanRemortel
programme.desc: This week on Larry Smith Outdoors we head to Northern Wisconsin and hook up with our buddy Jeff VanRemortel to fish for Walleyes and get the chance to SIGHT FISH crappies!! Always a fun day in the boat with Jeff! See what we find!

programme.title: 2021 AIM Walleye Champion on Lake Petenwall
programme.desc: On this week's episode, we head up to Lake Petenwall for the 2021 AIM Walleye National Championship! We have over 30 teams from all over the midwest competing to win the grand prize of a brand new Warrior 1898!

programme.title: MONSTER Lake of the Woods Walleye
programme.desc: This week we head up to Lake of the Woods to find some MONSTER walleyes! We hook up with Joe Henry who runs the tourism for lake of the woods! He showed us a great day of fishing and even got to do some sight seeing in Baudette!!

programme.title: How to Catch Perch in Summer! (Tips-Tricks)
programme.desc: On this week's episode we show you how to catch summer perch! Teaming up with Brian Zupke and Pete Hupf we chase down these tasty fish using the garmin livescope and hummingbird side imaging. Using gold Aberdeen hooks and trout worms we got into a pile of them!

programme.title: Brook Trout Adventure (Catch/Clean/Cook)
programme.desc: This week on Larry Smith Outdoors, we hook up with our friend Matt Sween for a brook trout adventure! We show you how to fish the right streams and how to clean and cook these brookies! What a fun day, see what we find!!

programme.title: Smart Tactics For Summer Perch
programme.desc: This week on Larry Smith Outdoors we stick close to home and head with the Boys from Leroys for a great day of perch and walleye fishing! We went out targeting perch but nothing wrong with a little walleye to start the day off. Tons of great tips about perch whether you're casting or drifting. Stay tuned!!

programme.title: River Fishing Tips for Top Water
programme.desc: This week on Larry Smith Outdoors we head up to marinette with our buddy BAC. I love fishing rivers and Brian is always a great time in the boat and he never disappoints with the fishing either!

programme.title: Sturgeon Fishing in the Rainy River!!
programme.desc: This week we head up to the Rainy River to fish for sturgeon. What a cool experience to target such a unique fish! Bass and pike are always fun too of course. Never quite know what you might hook into when you drop a bait in the Rainy!!

programme.title: 7th Annual David Andersen Memorial Warrior Shootout
programme.desc: In this week's episode, we head to Lake of the Woods for the 7th annual David Andersen Warrior Boats Rally! The Warrior family comes together and the memories and friendships were amazing! The fishing was tough and the weather was brutal but that's why we love our Warriors!

programme.title: Trolling for Lake Michigan Giants
programme.desc:
This week on Larry Smith Outdoors, we head to Lake Michigan by way of the Milwaukee Harbor for a bite that's on fire! This time around we trolled for Lake trout, Salmon and some other species on a charter boat.
Rob from Manhardt Charters shows us how to cover a lot of ground and locate the big fish out of the piles . Afterwards, Shotgun Chef shows out a couple of great recipes with Shotgun Chef. This is truly Great Lakes fishing action at its finest. Subscribe to our channel for the latest fishing reports across the Midwest!

programme.title: Larry's BIGGEST BUCK! (Minnesota Muzzleloader Hunt)
programme.desc: On this weeks episode we head over to Minnesota for a muzzleloader deer hunt! Larry is in the right place at the right time and shoots his biggest buck ever!

programme.title: All About The Kids
programme.desc: Legends of the Outdoors Hall of Famer, Phillip Vanderpool, introduces two new kids to the Outdoors at Triple H Outfitters in Kansas.

programme.title: Hunting Pheasants with Double Up Outfitters
programme.desc: Garry Mason, Jeff Milam, and Phillip Vanderpool join hall of famer Jerry Antley in North East Missouri on a Pheasant hunt with Double Up Outfitters.

programme.title: Slow down for more birds
programme.desc:
You set the pace in the field, and if you're in a rush so is your dog. That means less time in a scent cone and more missed birds.
Scott Linden of Wingshooting USA TV shows you how, and explains why, you should dial things down a bit when it comes to covering a field or covert.
If you want more tips on dog training and bird hunting, go to: www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Hunting dog tailgate exam, part one
programme.desc:
Your best hunting partner needs some TLC ... especially after a hunt. wingshooting USA TV host Scott Linden provides the first part of three, helping you check him from nose tip to tail and ensure he's healthy, safe, and ready to go the next day.
Today, it's all about your dog's coat. We'll cover why it's important to get him off the ground, how "training" for the exam is critical, and what to look for from injuries to parasites. Your dog will stay healthier, well-rested, and ready to go the next day.
You'll also see some fun and exciting bird hunting footage from a hunt where the tailgate exam became crucial.

programme.title: Take a newcomer hunting - here's how
programme.desc:
Safety first, but then what? Author and TV host Scott Linden outlines some ways to encourage, motivate, and then help a new hunter on their first hunt.
From weather to shooting tips, to interacting with the dog, and what really counts on the hunt, Scott offers suggestions to ensure everyone has fun.
For more tips on hunting, dog training, and finding places to go: www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Identify your best prospect for a new hunter
programme.desc:
Picking the right new hunting partner is an art and a science ... and while there's no wrong way, some ways are righter than others. Author/TV host Scott Linden outlines some tips on finding the right person, how to set expectations, and what to tell them - and show them - before you make "the ask."
For more tips, go to www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: The new-hunter best recruiter is your dog!
programme.desc:
Who doesn't love hunting dogs? The magic of their performance, excitement, and the adrenaline rush of a flush! One easy way to start a new hunter is to invite them to help train your dog.
Simple, short, convenient - there's no downside. And who wouldn't appreciate a little help with dog training?
Plus, some cool footage of a hunt with excellent dog works.
For more on starting a hunter, finding places to hunt, and dog training, go to www.findbirdhuntingspots.com.

programme.title: Ideas for finding new places to hunt
programme.desc:
Find upland birds on waterfowl production areas, and more tips on accessing public hunting areas are two of the topics ... as well as a great place to headquarter: Huron, South Dakota.
Watch some exciting bird hunting footage, too.
Find more information at www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Tailgate exam, part 2: wheels
programme.desc:
Part two covers your dog's "wheels," his feet. Enure a fantastic hunt tomorrow by keeping his feet healthy and injury-free with these step-by-step, toe-by-toe instructions.
Geet the entire exam in written form at HappyJackInc.com.

programme.title: Be nice, see where it gets you
programme.desc:
Walk-in hunting spots are not always easy to find. Here's an example of how to find them and the bonuses you might find along the way.
From hunting with a pro baseball player, to finding a black pheasant, to discovering new public-access spots in Huron, SD, there's a few lessons here.
Plus, some fun footage of a South Dakota pheasant hunt.
For more tips, go to www.findbirdhuntingspots.com

programme.title: Peak performance on Day Two: feed your dog strategically
programme.desc:
In the first 20 days of this season, my wirehair Flick had already hunted over 200 miles. He still scratches the RV door every morning, eager for another day of chukar chasing and quail quests.
I manage to keep up (mostly) with coffee and pain reliever. Flick, on the other paw, gets his stamina from Dr. Tim's dog food.
If your dog hunts multiple days in a row, it might be worth a look at how important food is to his performance. I asked Doctor Tim Hunt to share his thoughts on that, but first, a hunting story.

programme.title: Tailgate exam, Part 3: His steering wheel
programme.desc:
Okay, we've checked his body, his feet. But the tailgate exam isn't over until you've checked a dog's head – the steering wheel of your hunting machine. Like your truck, you're not getting very far without one! Put off that tall cold one for a couple more minutes. You'll have a fully-functioning hunting partner for the next day … and you won't die of thirst!
In this video, I'll show you where to look, what to look for and why ... and also how to remedy most common issues that might kibosh your next day's hunt, from getting stuff out of eyes and ears, to ensuring weeds and crud stay outta those places and more!
I'll take you step-by-step through all the deep, dark places that harbor danger and irritation on your dog's head so he's ready and rested for the next day's hunt.
And if you need remedies for any of the problems outlined, you can find them at www.happyjackinc.com.

programme.title: Get high, become a better bird hunter
programme.desc:
Not like that! I mean, boost your altitude - even just a bit - and you'll be able to keep a closer eye on your dog. If you're paying attention, you'll have a crucial half-second extra to get ready for a safe, sure shot.
I'll show you how - what you might use to get "up there" a little, what to look for in your dog's behavior, and why it's worth the effort.

programme.title: What's in my vest ... and why
programme.desc:
"Don't leave home without" is more than a cliche' from a TV commercial. What should you take on your next bird hunt, for you and your dog? Here's some advice on critical stuff, and what you might leave home ... without jeopardizing your safety or comfort - or you're dog's!
Somewhere in my personal vest is everything I need to shoot as well as possible (no smart remarks, please), stay found or get found, keep my dog safe and healthy, and help me survive a night or two in an emergency.
I'll show you all of it, and how to keep it from getting lost somewhere in the middle of nowhere!

programme.title: Your dog hurts - here's why
programme.desc:
I seem to be getting a lot of related questions since the season ended – most about aches and pains in our four-footed hunting buddies. And us!
The difference is, dogs won't show it like we do, with gripes and limping, complaints and wincing. They are way too loyal and hard working. It's why we love 'em.
You might already know this, but veterinarians tell me dogs seldom show pain. What they do, is slow down. Their pace in the field drags, they're slow to get out of their crate.
Maybe they won't jump onto your tailgate or training table.
That's probably arthritis, and it affects most dogs over eight years old. But here's the scary part: twenty percent of dogs show signs as early as one year old.
In this video, I'll show you how to prevent arthritis, manage it if your dog already has it, and what to avoid so he doesn't get it prematurely!

programme.title: Fuel your bird dog's peak performance ... but NOT with carbs!
programme.desc:
We hunt to watch our dogs work. So, stand by for plenty of that. But first, let me relate my last season. I tracked Flick's mileage. He averaged twenty-five miles a day, over almost fifty days in the field. I'm a lousy shooter, and okay trainer … so I'll attribute his stamina to my dumb luck, and his performance dog food.
If you want to watch your dog in the field day after day, heed some of the advice I got from Doctor Tim Hunt, a veterinarian, sled dog racer, and developer of the food Flick eats. He says the fuel you put in your dog directly impacts his ability to hunt hard, especially on a long hunting trip. He should know. His food has powered a bunch of Iditarod winners … and my guy Flick.
In this video, you'll learn what the key ingredients are in a dog food, how they work, and why. Hint: the most important component in your dog food is probably NOT what you think it is.

programme.title: Bird dog training: one (baby) step at a time
programme.desc: Dogs learn in a linear fashion, so in this video Scott shows you how important it is to break a complex task into smaller pieces. Training one piece at a time ensures a compliant, happy, peak-performing hunting buddy.

programme.title: Not Another Black Movie
programme.desc:
Not Another Black Movie stars Damon Williams (Bad Boys of Comedy, Comic View, BET LIVE, The Tom Joyner Morning Show), Janet Hubert (The Fresh Prince of Bel-Air), Rodney Perry (The Monique Show, Who's Got Jokes) Jay Davis (Not Another Zombie Movie, Shots Fired), and Leon Rogers (WGCI, Comic View, Bad Boys of Comedy).
Not Another Black Movie is not only a spoof of a genre often associated with Tyler Perry films, but a satirical look at family dysfunction as well. Written by Jay Davis and Directed by Donte "Diesel" Williams, Not Another Black Movie addresses issues that effect many families whether they be rich or poor, black or white. Although we poke fun at some of the stereotypical roles portrayed in this genre, we hope to shed some light on problems that plague many families while giving you a good laugh.

programme.title: BEONDTV is a Los Angeles-based broadcast and digital media network with a wide variety of original programming curated by Emmy award-winning journalists and content creators.
BEONDTV is a Los Angeles-based broadcast and digital media network with a wide variety of original programming curated by Emmy award-winning journalists and content creators.
Wild Ones - S01:E10 - Micro Predators
programme.desc: They may be small but don’t be fooled - micro predators can be deadly. From the impressive serial killer Portia spider to the hundreds of species of ants and the archerfish with its precision firing of water droplets to secure its prey Wild Ones peers through the microscope to uncover their true lethality.

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E11 - Most Poisonous_
programme.desc: You wouldn’t want to be bitten by any of these but which one has the deadliest poison? The venom from the most poisonous snake on the planet? A rare poisonous lizard? Or is it the blue ringed octopus?

programme.title: Wild Ones - S01:E12 - Migration
programme.desc: Animals, big and not so big, traverse hundreds of miles – some in search of food, others to find ideal breeding grounds. From Zebras crossing the savannahs of Africa to the huge journeys undertaken by turtles to find the perfect beach to lay their eggs – the annual and often dangerous journeys are simply mind boggling.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E06 - Naturally Miraculous
programme.desc: In the rain forests of the Seychelles we encounter remarkable fauna and flora. Then on to Mauritius. Where the symbol of the cruel and inconsiderate colonization of Africa is the extinct Dodo bird. We conclude today’s episode in the very heart of Africa, in the only place on the planet where close relatives to humans, the mountain gorillas - live. The country is the Democratic Republic of Congo and the province we shall visit is South Kivu.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E07 - Naturally Fascinating
programme.desc: Bolivia is a country of countless fascinating natural sights. We will begin on the high plateau of Altiplano, stopping by the world’s largest salt lake.Later, we will descend a few thousand meters using the road of death to the Los Yungas province. And then on to the shores of lake Titicaca, the highest navigable lake in the world.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S02:E08 - Naturally Harmonious
programme.desc: Zambia, the Latvian region of Kurzeme, the Georgian provinces of Kakheti and Svaneti, seem to have very little in common. They lie in Africa, Europe and on the borderline between Europe and Asia respectively. Kakheti and Svaneti are both a part of Georgia but very unlike one another. So where is the connection? How are these regions similar?

programme.title: Royal Documentaries - S01:E35 - Prince Charles At 50 Heir To Sadness
programme.desc: After Diana's death, everyone's attention turned to Charles, who was not only a widower and a dad but also next in line for the throne. This show takes a closer look at how he got along with his sons, his longtime love Camilla, and what his future might look like as King. Royal experts David Starkey and Anthony Holden share their insights.

programme.title: Wardens - S02:E06 - Operation Bitterroot
programme.desc: Montana's Game Wardens have their hands full on the first day of big game season. Tag along as they check out the Bitterroot game area. And to nab poachers, they've got a clever sting operation going, using a mobile decoy.

programme.title: Dropped - S02:E08 - End of the Line
programme.desc: While Chris hears the bull getting closer, he can't spot it. Casey, however, has a clear view. They attempt to communicate with hand signals, but the bull vanishes over the mountain, out of sight.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E10 - Naturally Potent
programme.desc: Explore the unspoilt mountains of Lapland and on to the pristine Swiss Alps. In contrast we then travel to Champagne Province in France - home of the finest wines in the world. Finally, Gibraltar beckons with its long history and strange mysterious caves.

programme.title: Miracles of Nature - S01:E11 - Naturally Different
programme.desc: The Shetland Islands: home to 20,000 humans, one million birds and the smallest horse in the world. Then on to an area known to the locals as the Centre of the World in South Eastern province of Kazakhstan. From there we will go to the Yellow Mountains in Central China often called The Venice of China.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show - S01:E13 - Barbados and Lake Como
programme.desc: Barbados has it all. Home to The Cliff, one of the world’s most famous restaurants where sharks swim in the floodlit bay and entertain diners. Considered by many to be the best of the Caribbean Islands it is home to media moguls and pop princesses alike. Italy’s Lake Como also plays host to a number of famous Hollywood stars and directors who’ve fallen in love with its breath-taking vistas and fabulous cuisine.

programme.title: The Luxury Travel Show - S01:E01 - Chiang Mai and Eze
programme.desc: Nestled in the foothills of northern Thailand, Chiang Mai is the country’s fifth largest city. Brimming with culture, beautiful architecture and stunning temples it’s often considered a sanctuary away from Bangkok. In the South of France, nestled between Nice and Monte Carlo is the picture postcard town of Eze.

programme.title: Jim Shockey's Uncharted - S01:E12 - The Last Hunters
programme.desc: Arctic Pt3. The Inuit take Jim and Corey on their last adventure together. Jim finds inspiration from empty stretches of broken ice and the people who live off it.

programme.title: Harry & Meghan: A Very Modern Romance
programme.desc: Meghan Markle and Prince Harry share similar interests and seem like a perfect match. Both have faced tough times growing up but have come out on top. Now they're winning together. This hour-long special, featuring a chat with author Andrew Morton, explores the social backdrop that makes their bold marriage fit right in with today's British Royal Family.

programme.desc: The most notable woman in modern times has to be our Late Queen, Elizabeth II. She ruled for 70 years, the longest reign in British history. In a thousand years of British monarchy, Elizabeth II is likely one of the most outstanding monarchs ever.

programme.desc: As they were having dinner, Casey noticed a bear wandering on the hill. Both he and R.L. sprinted through the rain, trying to get closer. Meanwhile, Chris was getting fed up with staying in the tent.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E07 - High Water
programme.desc: Chris and Kaid, who have been stuck in the tent for several days, finally get a break when the weather improves. They realize the rain has caused the river to rise to dangerous levels. Still, their hunt for big animals continues.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E08 - Moose Fever
programme.desc: Chris and Kaid are on the trail of a huge bull moose, and Kaid lines up the shot. Meanwhile, Casey and R.L. are still on the hunt for big game. The river levels remain stubbornly high and wild.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E09 - Weary Travellers
programme.desc: R.L. and Casey travel far from their camp to reach the heart of moose country as the rut begins. Meanwhile, Chris looks into finding a new way out because of the rough weather.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E10 - Lifted
programme.desc: As their Alaskan adventure wraps up, Kaid and R.L. think about what really counts in life and what they've discovered about living. Lifelong bonds are stronger than ever as they get ready to leave Alaska.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E06 - Flood
programme.desc: When the levee breaks, the stuff really hits the fan…. Desperate Hours looks at some of the most devastating floods in history including the flood of Rio De Janeiro in Brazil, the Louisiana floods in the United States, the Hamburg floods in Germany, the Uttarakhand floods in North India, and the Indian Ocean tsunami in Southeast Asia.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E07 - Geological Disasters
programme.desc: Sometimes, all that it takes is a shift underfoot…. Desperate Hours looks at major geological disasters including avalanches in Afghanistan, Pakistan, Nepal, Peru, and France. It also looks at geological landslides in the Philippines, India and Columbia and an enormous sinkhole that consumed a pond in Bosnia. It also looks at Blizzards in the United States, Israel, and United Kingdom.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E08 - Nuclear Industrial
programme.desc: When humans are a serious danger to themselves ... Desperate Hours looks at nuclear and industrial disasters including the Fukushima Nuclear Power Plant disaster in Japan, the Chernobyl Nuclear Power Plant disaster in Ukraine, the Deepwater Oil Spill in the Gulf of Mexico, the Savar Plaza disaster in Bangladesh, and the Bhopal Gas disaster in India. When a catastrophic event strikes a nuclear power facility the resulting disaster can be, literally, off the scale and last for decades.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E09 - Disaster at Sea
programme.desc: Seafaring is a dangerous business indeed…… Desperate Hours looks at major disasters on the high seas including the Sewol Ferry disaster in South Korea, the Ferry Estonia in the Baltic Sea, the sinking of the Titanic, the Exxon Valdez in Prince William Sound Alaska, the Express Samina in Portes Islets, pirates attacking the Maersk Alabama and Seabourn Spirit, and the Costa Concordia in the Mediterranean Sea.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E10 - Disaster in the Air
programme.desc: Where the black box is the only story teller…… Airplane crashes are most people’s worst nightmares. Desperate Hours looks at major disasters in aviation history including Malaysia Airlines MH17 and MH370, Air France Flight 447, Germanwings Flight 9525, the Tenerife airport disaster, the Challenger and Columbia space shuttle disasters, the 2015 Sumatra Indonesian Air Force C-130 crash, the 1997 Irkutsk Antonov An-124 crash, and the Concorde Flight 4590 crash.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E01 - A Family Affair
programme.desc: In the remote corners of the Alaskan bush country are bounties unlike any other. Rugged, raw and now cooked - this is the last culinary frontier where one chef is redefining what it means to eat like a wild man. Finicky clients, bi-polar weather changes, and food and supply shortages often push Bradley to the last ounce of his sanity but this creative, free-spirit always seems to deliver.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E02 - Surfers' Delight
programme.desc: In the Planet's ultimate test kitchen this episode serves up a special dinner for a group of surfers but there is a storm coming. This will be one to remember. On the menu a mixed green salad with a raspberry vinaigrette, whitefish gelatine with cucumber and corn relish following by seared halibut and polenta.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E03 - Hunters Paradise
programme.desc: Catering off the grid isn't easy and the Ewing Family knows it. A group of 8 hunters will be served a beet salad followed by braised venison and for desert cheesecake with lingonberries.

programme.title: Alaska's Wild Gourmet - S01:E04 - Celebration
programme.desc: Another 5 Star meal from the Ewing Family. This time it is a dinner for some local natives. Bradley decides to go on a hunt for a goat for the first course of slow braised goat ragout, followed by a fish risotto, and for the main course - curried goat with apple and rose hip chutney and to complete the dinner a chocolate molten lava cake for desert.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E06 - Bearing Down
programme.desc: As they were having dinner, Casey noticed a bear wandering on the hill. Both he and R.L. sprinted through the rain, trying to get closer. Meanwhile, Chris was getting fed up with staying in the tent.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E07 - High Water
programme.desc: Chris and Kaid, who have been stuck in the tent for several days, finally get a break when the weather improves. They realize the rain has caused the river to rise to dangerous levels. Still, their hunt for big animals continues.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E08 - Moose Fever
programme.desc: Chris and Kaid are on the trail of a huge bull moose, and Kaid lines up the shot. Meanwhile, Casey and R.L. are still on the hunt for big game. The river levels remain stubbornly high and wild.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E09 - Weary Travellers
programme.desc: R.L. and Casey travel far from their camp to reach the heart of moose country as the rut begins. Meanwhile, Chris looks into finding a new way out because of the rough weather.

programme.title: Dropped - S04:E10 - Lifted
programme.desc: As their Alaskan adventure wraps up, Kaid and R.L. think about what really counts in life and what they've discovered about living. Lifelong bonds are stronger than ever as they get ready to leave Alaska.

programme.title: Desperate Hours - S01:E06 - Flood
programme.desc: When the levee breaks, the stuff really hits the fan…. programme.title: 10 Inch Hero
programme.desc: An artist gets a job at a beachside sandwich shop, where she hangs out with a techie, a flirt, a rocker, a hippie, and a Wiccan.

programme.title: Alien Trespass
programme.desc: After crash landing on the outskirts of a desert town, an alien enlists the help of a local waitress to recapture a monster that has escaped the wreckage of his spaceship in this affectionate, knowing, hilarious send-up of a genreís sillier past.

programme.title: Eavesdrop
programme.desc: Ensemble drama about conversations overheard in a bistro: two chess players see unfolding dramas, a couple on an uncomfortable blind date, a crumbling marriage, and film-noir fans that think they're witnessing a real-life murder.

programme.title: Citizen Duane
programme.desc: CITIZEN DUANE is a comedy/drama about Duane Balfour a teen-aged Don Quixote born into a family of spectacular failure. What starts as a simple schoolyard rivalry snowballs out of control when Duane decides to run for mayor of the tiny town of Ridgeway. If Duane is to succeed, he must not only overcome the powerful incumbents, but also his own inadequacies, public perception, and history itself.

programme.title: Comedy Meets Classic
programme.desc: Created by British comedy duo Carrington-Brown, based in Berlin, and Irish conductor ClA�odhna NA� AodA�in, based in Switzerland. They join forces with "The Swonderful Orchestra" for this exciting, classy, and hilarious music & comedy show.

programme.title: Flirting With Flamenco
programme.desc: When Sylvia's well-meaning dad (Watt) surprises her with a devastating revelation, Sylvia's world is turned upside down. But will she crumble or prove herself at the local flamenco contest? An uplifting feel-good Brit comedy drama, Flirting with Flamenco will have you laughing, crying and feeling empowered to turn your life around.

programme.title: Citizen Duane
programme.desc: CITIZEN DUANE is a comedy/drama about Duane Balfour a teen-aged Don Quixote born into a family of spectacular failure. What starts as a simple schoolyard rivalry snowballs out of control when Duane decides to run for mayor of the tiny town of Ridgeway. If Duane is to succeed, he must not only overcome the powerful incumbents, but also his own inadequacies, public perception, and history itself.

programme.title: The Flying Deuces
programme.desc: When two bumbling friends join the French Foreign Legion on a whim, they find themselves in a whirlwind of misadventures, love, and laughter as they attempt to navigate the challenges of military life in a foreign land.

programme.title: Perfect Girl
programme.desc: A coming of age romance for anyone who's ever had a crush. Since high school, Stan and Jenny have had crushes on each other. They wrote letters to one another over school holidays but in person they barely spoke; sharing only the occasional lingering glance and smile. Over the years they fantasized about how perfect they would be as lovers. Ten years later they bump into each other and have the chance to make it a reality, but it's not that simple; self doubt, fear of rejection, of losing their fantasies will hold them back from what could be the perfect union.

programme.title: I Would Have Kissed You
programme.desc: Three months after college graduation, best friends Mattie and Olivia are struggling to write a feature and struggling even more with their love lives. Mattie finds herself in a grey area with her college ex-boyfriend while Olivia clings to the hope that her crush will finally want to be with her (despite his hot new girlfriend.) British Web Awards - Awarded "Best Writing in a Dramedy" and "Best Music" Top Indie Awards -Awarded "Best Humor" WRPN Women's International Film Festival - Awarded "Exceptional Merit Award"

programme.title: The General
programme.desc: When Union spies steal Johnnie Gray's (Buster Keaton) beloved locomotive, the General, he pursues them with the aid of his fiance, Annabelle Lee (Marion Mack) straight through enemy lines. One of the most revered comedies of the silent era.

programme.title: Finding Joy
programme.desc: A struggling writer rediscovers himself, his offbeat family, and what it means to be happy when he meets Joy – a spirited, possibly-dying young woman who asks him to write her obituary.

programme.title: Brazzy Jazzy
programme.desc: When a Brazilian Girl takes on the NYC fashion world, her adventures are sometimes sexy, often funny but always Caffeinated! It's Jane the Virgin meets Girls, only an outsider immigrant version - more like Girls of the 3rd World.

programme.title: Growing Op
programme.desc: In an average American neighborhood, a family of four breaks all conformity making it difficult for their 18 year old son to fit in to society.

programme.desc: In a last ditch effort to save their marriage, Nick and Willa visit a renowned, yet eccentric, couples therapist and embark on a month-long journey of provocative and hilarious sex assignments.

programme.title: Whaddyado - Athlete Collapses
programme.desc: A boy catches fire and a young onlooker has what it takes to tackle the situation. * An athlete collapses in the weight room and a race against the clock begins trying to revive him. * A moral dilemma segment examines an inappropriate teacher-student relationship.

programme.title: ChatRoom - Self Cutting
programme.desc: An adult host and a panel of four young adults discuss dilemmas, scenarios and situations that are relevant to kids' lives.
