programme.title: ChatRoom - Dad's Dating
programme.desc: An adult host and a panel of four young adults discuss dilemmas, scenarios and situations that are relevant to kids' lives. This week’s topics include: Her boyfriend is all hands and it’s making her uncomfortable. Also, mom died and now dad’s dating – how do you feel about it?

programme.title: ChatRoom - Teacher / Student
programme.desc: ChatRoom focuses on the ever-changing issues for today’s teens in a format that invites viewers to listen in on the conversation. This week’s topics include: What are the implications when a teacher makes a pass at a student? And “Sexting” sounds exciting but there’s a lot to consider before you hit send.

programme.title: Awesome Adventures - Brazil
programme.desc: The South American country of Brazil serves as the backdrop for our adventures this week. On day one we experience Avorismo, a trip that begins with tree climbing and ends with a splash. Day two starts with Olodum, a Brazilian percussion session that we beat like a drum and we take in Projeto Tamar to learn all about the varieties of sea turtles that call Brazil home. We shake things up on day three as we learn how to dance the samba then visit the city and experience the culture of Salvador, Bahia. We finish our adventures by training in the Brazilian martial art of Capoeria and leave things up in the air as we try our hand at juggling.

programme.title: Awesome Adventures - Quebec
programme.desc: On this week’s show we’ll visit Quebec City, Quebec. First, we’ll visit the Citadel and experience what it’s like to be a cadet. Then we’re off to learn all there is to know about maple sugaring. Next, we go on a bee safari and discover things we didn’t know about bees. Then, we’ll try yachting. To wrap up the show, we have some fun go-carting.

programme.title: Awesome Adventures - Las Vegas
programme.desc: This week’s “Awesome Adventure” takes place in the city of Las Vegas. We’ll attempt a unique type of skydiving…one that takes place indoors. Then we’ll head outdoors taking to the sky in some old fashioned WW II biplanes. We’ll visit the world famous Hoover Dam and then we’ll meet up with some circus folk and learn a few tricks of the trade. Finally, we’ll visit Lake Mead for a jet skiing adventure, and the Valley of Fire for some four wheelin’ fun.

programme.title: Wild About Animals - Powerful Predators
programme.desc: This show is dedicated to some of the world’s most powerful predators- from sharks in the Gulf of Mexico, to eagles and wolves in Minnesota. We’ll also explore the controversial topic of whether large predators should be kept in captivity in places like Zoo’s and SeaWorld.

programme.title: Wild About Animals - Canned Hunting
programme.desc: Come visit a college in southern California that teaches courses like Exotic Animal Training to prospective animal trainers. Then, look at the gruesome, but legal sport of canned hunting. And don’t forget that many victims of natural disasters are animals, often left behind to fend for themselves or perish. Now, the Humane Society offers to help pets in need when disaster strikes. Finally we’ll see the Shambala preserve, a haven for endangered, exotic big cats.

programme.title: Wild About Animals - Yellowstone
programme.desc: This week we’ll travel to Yellowstone National Park and visit the animals that inhabit this national wonder. We’ll also meet photographers Russ Finley and Tom Murphy, who make a living out in the wild. Then learn more about the dog’s canine cousins the wolf and the coyote.

programme.title: Whaddyado - Car Fire
programme.desc: A routine trip to visit some relatives literally takes a turn for the worse. *A trooper arrives on the scene of a car fire and someone’s trapped inside the burning vehicle. *A young man’s car is immobilized by rapidly rising water and he can’t open the door.*A woman pulls into her driveway and catches a burglar in the act.

programme.title: Whaddyado - Car Fall
programme.desc: A car falls on a man’s chest and his teenage nephew must find the strength to help solve this weighty problem and save his uncle’s life. * A bicycle brake impales a young boy’s leg and the resulting wound is more serious than anyone thought. * A moral dilemma segment deals with how to handle a stalker.

programme.title: Whaddyado - Kitchen Fire
programme.desc: * The son of a firefighter proves he can stand the heat in a kitchen on fire.* A young girl pulls off a great escape when she fights off an ex-con trying to abduct her. * This week we take a closer look at the alarming trend of cutting or self-injury among teens

programme.title: ChatRoom - Stalking
programme.desc: An adult host and a panel of four young adults discuss dilemmas, scenarios and situations that are relevant to kids' lives. This week’s topics include: Someone is stalking you. How do you handle it? And what happens if you don’t get into the college of your choice?

programme.title: ChatRoom - Cyber Bully
programme.desc: An adult host and a panel of four young adults discuss dilemmas, scenarios and situations that are relevant to kids' lives. This week’s topics include: A coach who takes motivation to the extreme. And cyber bullying is becoming more and more common. What can you do about it?

programme.title: ChatRoom - Bad Mother
programme.desc: This week’s topics include: He seems familiar, but will he take them for a ride? And Mom makes an offer that could change the whole party. Is she a cool mom or a poor parent? If teens are thinking about it or feeling it, we’re discussing it, in the ChatRoom.

programme.title: Awesome Adventures - Islands
programme.desc: On this week’s “Awesome Adventures,” we’ll travel to the Bahamas to watch a trained troop of flamingos, visit an 18th century fort, and learn how to make a traditional Bahamian dish. We’ll experience the adventure of a lifetime as we venture into shark-infested waters. Then we’ll learn all about sailing as we hit the open waters.

programme.title: Iceland

programme.title: Awesome Adventures - Thailand
programme.desc: This week we head to Southeast Asia to spend time in Phuket, Thailand.

programme.desc: This episode features the best of 1996/1997 season. From the underwater world of the Great Barrier Reef to the Serengeti in Africa, visit the extraordinary places and animals highlighted in this presentation of “Wild About Animals.”

programme.title: Wild About Animals - Alaska Raven
programme.desc: On this episode of “Wild About Animals,” we’ll watch as one man wrestles alligators for a living. We’ll go to Anchorage, Alaska to find out the truth about the mysterious raven. Then, we’ll look at a sport for dogs that requires athletic ability and teamwork that some say is the ultimate game of fetch. The sport is called flyball, and all kinds of dogs just love it. And we’ll visit a place that rescues, rehabilitates and releases injured seals and sea lions.

programme.title: Countdown To Apollo - Factor Fiction
programme.desc: This episode examines some of the popular notions surrounding the Apollo program and discerns whether they are fact or fiction. These include: were Neil Armstrong’s words when he stepped on the moon scripted by Nasa? Products such as Velcro and Teflon are thought to be invented during the space program: true or false? Did President Kennedy try to work together with the Soviet Union to get a man on the moon? These and more are featured in Fact or Fiction.

programme.title: Countdown To Apollo - Amiable Strangers
programme.desc: Three very different, uniquely talented men came together to form the crew of Apollo 11. Neil Armstrong, the skilled pilot, Buzz Aldrin, the astronaut with a PhD, and Mike Collins, the well-liked pilot of the command module. This episode looks at all three men, not only in their professional capacities, but their personalities as well. They were, as Mike Collins described them, “amiable strangers.”

This episode reveals the amazingly diverse superpowers of well-known sharks, like the Great White and hammerhead, as well as lesser-known sharks, like the super stealthy wobbegong, the epaulette shark’s stunning ability to walk on land, the Greenland shark’s death-defying lifespan, and more.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space - Space Disasters
programme.desc: Emily Calandrelli uncovers the most prominent disasters in space exploration & the lessons learned.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space - Space The Amusement Park

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet - Glacier National Park
programme.desc: This week we head to the beautiful landscape of Glacier National Park.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet - Insects
programme.desc: We look at the wonderful world of insects.

programme.title: DIY Sci - Birthday Science
programme.desc: Steve Spangler is throwing a “science party” for his pal Higginsworth and you’re invited. Find out how to create an invisible party invitation, your own science snacks like gummy worms and a volcano cake, and the messiest confetti poppers you’ll ever see.

programme.title: DIY Sci - Candy Science
programme.desc: What happens when you set gummy bears on fire? Steve Spangler dishes up some sweet science with do-it-yourself experiments all using candy. You’ll discover the secret hidden on every M&M plus a new way to harness the explosive power of Mentos and diet soda.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 - Living Spaces In Space
programme.desc: By 2050, astronauts may be using 3D printers to build homes on other planets.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 - Techs Next Generation
programme.desc: The STEM initiative is getting a big boost from both the private, and public, sectors.

programme.title: Nature Knows Best - Medical Science

programme.title: Nature Knows Best - NASA Studies Nature
programme.desc: Danni Washington visits NASA to learn how biomimicry is being used for space exploration.

programme.title: Super Animals - Underwater Wonders
programme.desc: Our oceans are filled with incredible creatures that have amazing superpowers! In this episode, we’ll break down how the octopus pulls off such extreme physical transformations, reveal the manatee’s super sense, find out how some jellyfish glow, reveal just how intelligent dolphins are, and discover a beautiful but lethal hunter lurking along the ocean floor.

programme.title: Super Animals - X-Treme Adaptors
programme.desc: Each of these animals proves that extreme adaptations are key to survival. In this episode, we’ll take a deep dive into some of the most bizarre and amazing natural adaptations out there – like the only venomous primate in the world, the way the camel is able to survive the hottest and driest places on Earth, the land snail’s super gift for “sleeping” away death, the wood frog’s “suspended animation” mode, and more.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space - Exoplanets
programme.desc: Join host Emily Calandrelli as she explores the fascinating world of exoplanets.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space - Why We Explore
programme.desc: Emily Calandrelli makes the case for space exploration and why we should explore beyond our planet.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet - Natural Distasters
programme.desc: We see how science helps us prepare for natural disasters.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet - Nature's Classroon
programme.desc: We see how nature can sometimes be the best classroom.

programme.desc: Host Steve Spangler and his sidekick Higginsworth explore the Museum of Science, Boston, for new do-it-yourself science tricks and experiments.

programme.desc: Steev Letts has performed at Just for Laughs VANCOUVER and the Grindstone Comedy Festival, and his debut album Burger Queen is available online.

programme.title: Just for Laughs Presents: Sir Patrick Stewart: A Knight of Comedy
programme.desc: Sir Patrick Stewart, Knight of the Realm, brings all the wit, elegance, and gravitas you’d expect from a British thespian to the Just For Laughs stage. He’s a former member of the Royal Shakespeare Company and a fictional Star Ship captain, marking the first time a bona fide knight in shining armour has hosted a Just For Laughs gala. Join Sir Patrick for a star-studded evening of comedy, featuring the hilarious Sebastian Maniscalco, Gina Yashere, Russell Howard, Jim Breuer, and Pete Zedlacher.

programme.title: Just for Laughs Presents: - Chris Robinson: Panning for Gold

programme.title: Just for Laughs Presents: - Cheech & Chong : Puff Puff Laugh
programme.desc: The inventors of stoner comedy, legends Cheech & Chong are still jokin’ (and possibly smokin’). Catch them as they perform some of their funniest bits, recall some hilarious behind-the-scenes stories from their days of filming ‘Up In Smoke’ and host a full bag of the world’s funniest comedians. Included in the special are Last Comic Standing finalist Lavell Crawford, creator and star of the Brit cult comedy The Mighty Boosh Noel Fielding, the ever-opinionated Bill Burr, and Canada’s own rising star Jay Malone.

programme.title: Decline of the American Empire
programme.desc: Hosted by The Daily Show’s favourite Brit correspondent John Oliver, The Decline of the American Empire is the comedy dissection of our neighbours to the South… sort of a hilarious outsider’s State of the Union. It’s the smartest, most opinionated and politically-fuelled show in the lineup show, so get ready to piss your political trousers, speak your mind and have a look at the future, or lack thereof, of the USA.

programme.title: Night of One Million Opinions
programme.desc: Never the introvert, the Angriest Man in America Lewis Black hosts a roster of opinionated comics who just want to be heard, dammit! Along with Lewis spewing his usual bile about the state of everything, Derek Edwards pontificates on his driving frustrations, Dom Irrera thinks alcohol is wonderful, Kathleen Madigan has lost all hope for America, Greg Giraldo rants on about how women have all the power today, and Paul F Tompkins has probably the most incendiary topic of all. You’d be an idiot to miss it… then again, that’s just our opinion.

Along with Lewis spewing his usual bile about the state of everything, Derek Edwards pontificates on his driving frustrations, Dom Irrera thinks alcohol is wonderful, Kathleen Madigan has lost all hope for America, Greg Giraldo rants on about how women have all the power today, and Paul F Tompkins has probably the most incendiary topic of all. You’d be an idiot to miss it… then again, that’s just our opinion.

programme.title: Venturing Out: Park 2 Park - El Paso: Conquering Mountains
programme.desc: In El Paso, Texas, Raheim coaches new mom and aspiring mountain biker Isabel as she rides rocky desert descents in the Franklin Mountains. Then, Raheim visits an ancient bouldering field, Hueco Tanks, home to wild west graffiti and rock art.

programme.title: Love On the Rocks - Tying the Knot at 13,000 Feet
programme.desc: A romantic trip to Colorado takes a windy turn when Jason pushes Tayler, despite her hesitation, to summit Mt. Democrat in 70 mph winds and -19 degree weather.

programme.title: Love On the Rocks - A Newly-Wed Recipe for Disaster
programme.desc: Jason loves mountain biking. Tayler prefers to read a book. Jason is up for any adventure tossed at him. Tayler likes to be a bit more prepared. Will the adventures that await in Arkansas leave the couple questioning if they have anything in common?

programme.title: Love On the Rocks - Theodora's Room
programme.desc: Tayler and Jason travel to Eureka Springs, Arkansas, a town with a rich history and home to one of the most haunted hotels in America, The Crescent. Jason convinces Tayler to stay one night, but will that stay lead to a night they don't want to remember?

programme.title: Love On the Rocks - Trust Me!
programme.desc: Jason has attempted to climb the Grand Teton, located in Wyoming, three times before the couple's adventure out west. Will the fourth time be a charm? Or will life's unplanned moments present even greater challenges than Jason anticipated?

programme.title: National Parks Adventure - National Parks Adventure
programme.desc: A team of modern day explorers take an off-trail adventure through the national parks of the USA, showing the awe-inspiring beauty found within America’s most legendary outdoor playgrounds.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Paddling Juneau, Alaska
programme.desc: Ken Whiting travels to Juneau, Alaska to paddle with whales, bears, glaciers and icebergs on a multi-day sea kayaking adventure.

programme.title: USA Through Music - USA Through Music
programme.desc: American cities have long played a starring role in its music. Notable musicians tell personal stories about how their favorite cities inspire their work.

programme.title: Beach Battles - Beach Battles: Coney Island & Manitowoc
programme.desc: Coney Island, New York hosts its annual Mermaid Parade, and sand sculpting pros battle in Manitowoc, Wisconsin.

programme.title: Beach Battles - Beach Battles: Pacifica & Crisfield
programme.desc: Paddle into Dog Surfing in Pacifica, California, and get picking at the Crab Derby in Crisfield, Maryland.

programme.title: Beach Battles - Beach Battles: Winchester Bay & Long Beach
programme.desc: High-octane dune racing in Winchester Bay, Oregon, plus high-flying Kitefest fun in Long Beach, Washington.

programme.title: Beach Battles - Beach Battles: Key West & Wrightsville
programme.desc: Dive into the fun blowing conchs in Key West, Florida and race pro SUPS in Wrightsville Beach, North Carolina.

programme.title: USA Through Film - USA Through Film 3
programme.desc: American cities have long played a starring role in its cinema. Notable actors and directors, including Hilary Swank, Helen Hunt, and Colman Domingo, tell stories about their favorite U.S. cities.

programme.title: Epic Southern Road Trip - Savannah
programme.desc: The next stop on Sorted Food's Epic Southern Road Trip is Savannah, Georgia. In 48 hours they must learn all they can about local culture and cuisine before hosting a dinner party for local chefs to showcase what they’ve learned about Southern food and hospitality. Will the guys be able to learn enough in such a short period of time?

programme.title: Epic Southern Road Trip - Savannah Part 2
programme.desc: After exploring Savannah, Georgia for 48 hours learning the ropes of Southern food and hospitality, Chef Ben, Jamie and Mike try hosting a dinner party for local chefs, food writers and Savannah natives. How will these expectant locals react?

programme.title: Sorted Food: Game Changers - Puerto Rico Street Food Face Off
programme.desc: Sorted heads to Puerto Rico to find the best food this beautiful island has to offer.

programme.title: Epic Trails - Epic Trails: Backpacking West Virginia
programme.desc: Eric Hanson explores the mountains, trails and winter landscapes of West Virginia.

programme.title: One Perfect Day in Kentucky - One Perfect Day in Kentucky
programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: Adventure Cities - Adventure Cities
programme.desc: Jonathan Thompson explores the adventurous side of St. Petersburg Clearwater, Florida; Charleston, South Carolina; and Juneau, Alaska.

programme.title: America's Musical Journey - America's Musical Journey
programme.desc: A cross-country adventure through the musical heritage of America and the cultural cities where America's music was born.

programme.title: USA Through Film - USA Through Film 2
programme.desc: Actor and director Jordan Spiro (Ozark, Night Comes On) spent childhood vacations with her family in New Orleans. For Spiro, the city’s heritage as the birthplace of jazz is reflected in its mélange of arts and food culture that always feels fresh, inviting, and joyous, even after a lifetime of visits. “There’s this ‘all senses on overload’ side to New Orleans that takes my breath away every time.”

programme.title: Small Town, Big Story - Bridge Day
programme.desc: One day each year in Fayetteville, West Virginia, scores of people throw caution to the wind and jump off a 876' bridge into the Gorge below.

programme.title: Small Town, Big Story - Chili Capital of the World
programme.desc: Dylan explores the world of Hatch chilis and meets the farmers and community in this New Mexico valley known for bringing these unique peppers to life - one tingly, tasty, spicy bite at a time.

programme.title: Small Town, Big Story - Let’s Go Fly a Kite!
programme.desc: We learn the kite ballet and soar to new heights at the annual kite-festival in the blustery sea-side town of Morro Bay.

programme.title: Notes from the USA - Notes from the USA

programme.title: Sorted Food Goes Big in Texas - San Antonio Part 2
programme.desc: Chef Ben and the guys continue their Texas adventure in San Antonio, with a quick stop in the coastal city of Corpus Christi.

programme.title: Sorted Food Goes Big in Texas - Houston Part 1
programme.desc: Chef Ben and the gang arrive in Texas’ BIGGEST city, Houston. With new challenges in store, will they level the leaderboard?

programme.title: Sorted Food Goes Big in Texas - Houston Part 2
programme.desc: The Sorted guys go head to head in a street food fusion battle in Texas’ BIGGEST city, Houston. Who will come out on top?!

programme.title: Cheat Meal - Cheat Meal: Virginia Beach, Part 1
programme.desc: Tyler and Monica head to Virginia Beach where they’re tasked by celebrity chef Cliff Crooks to create the ultimate cheat meal for a local restaurateur. Armed with the power of their taste buds, the dynamic duo checks out the best places to eat, including Oishii Burger, Chick’s Oyster Bar and Klassic Doughnuts, to build an off-the-charts meal of epic portions.

programme.title: Cheat Meal - Cheat Meal: Virginia Beach, Part 2
programme.desc: Tyler and Monica dive back into Virginia Beach's vibrant food scene to build the ultimate cheat meal for George Culver, the food-loving force behind the popular @iheartfoodvb. From the tropical vibes at Moxy Virginia Beach to the game-filled hangouts at Beachside Social, and the delightful flavors of Oh Mochi, De Rican Chef, and Belvedere South, they pull out all the stops to craft a meal that’s as unforgettable as it is indulgent!

programme.title: Cheat Meal - Cheat Meal: Galveston

From the coastal vibes at Vida Agave to island-famous eats at The Spot, savory classics at Mario’s Seawall, local favorites at Mosquito Cafe, and indulgent sweets from Pattycakes Bakery, they turn up the heat to craft a cheat meal packed with bold flavors and Galveston flair.

programme.desc: In "One Perfect Day in Kentucky," BFF’s Kimberly and Elsa bring their shared competitive streak to the Bluegrass State, facing off to find out who can plan the perfect Kentucky day. Each is determined to delight - and outdo - the other with unforgettable experiences that showcase the state's rich culture. Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. As they ride the chairlift to the top of the stunning Natural Bridge, the rivalry kicks into high gear and they go head-to-head in a trivia battle. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

Elsa kicks off the competition with a classic Kentucky breakfast, a recipe she learned from top Chef Ouita Michel at her Holly Hill Cooking Studio. Elsa wins the first point, but Kimberly’s ready to up the ante, whisking Elsa away for a thrilling cave kayaking adventure at the Gorge Underground. The next surprise – a toast with Kentucky’s own Ale-8 soda , sourced by Kimberly straight from the factory only whets their whistles. At the Keeneland Racetrack they sip some spirit forward Keeneland Breezes while Elsa reveals all she has learned about racehorses from a visit to renowned trainer Mark Simms Jr. ‘s horse barn. A Betologist gives them a quick lesson on wagering and Kimberly’s horse wins the race. At Louisville’s Trouble Bar, Kimberly shares her newfound knowledge of Kentucky bourbon production from a tour and tasting at Castle + Key distillery and makes Elsa One Perfect Drink.

programme.title: N/A - Benny Loves You
programme.desc: Jack, a man desperate to improve his life throws away his beloved childhood plush, Benny. Its a move that has disastrous consequences when Benny springs to life with deadly intentions!

programme.title: Cannibals and Carpet Fitters
programme.desc: A group of carpet fitters are sent on a job to an old country house in the middle of nowhere. They soon discover it is a trap set up by a savage, cannibalistic family. The carpet fitters are forced to fight for their lives or risk ending up being the evenings dinner. Cannibals and Carpet Fitters is a gruesomely fun thrill ride that will keep you in your seat until the very last minute.

programme.title: Dread The Unsolved Season 5
programme.desc: A deep dive into the depths of unsolved murders, mysteries, and myths with narrator Jans Holstrom.

programme.title: The Curse of Audrey Earnshaw
programme.desc: A devout community suffering from a plague is torn apart by a beautiful young woman and the forces of witchcraft, black magic, and possession.

programme.title: Automation
programme.desc: A workplace robot, AUTO, transforms into a killing machine when he discovers he will be replaced by a more efficient model.

programme.title: Dark Sense
programme.desc: Simon, a young man with exceptional powers, tracks down a serial killer, battling not only his own demons but a government agency that has decided Simon is too dangerous to be allowed to roam free. Based on a bestseller by Peter Flannery.

programme.title: Babysitter Must Die
programme.desc: A wealthy family's home is invaded during a game of hide-and-seek by a pack cultists. Josie, the babysitter hides in plain sight prepared and armed with a handful of survival skills. She battles the cult and her fears through a long night of terror. Ultimately good defeats evil and she triumphs, but not before a cruel twist reveals the cult were just foot soldiers for a much greater evil.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 422 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 3 from Oradea, Romania. Up first in an ISKA Super Middleweight World Title match, Vinicius Bereta of Brazil takes on Adrian Maxim of Romania with the belt on the line. In the Colossal Division with a total of 723 pounds in the ring, Cristian Anheliuc and Sandu Lungu face off. The ISKA Super Middleweight Wordl title is on the line when Camaroon's Brice Kombou takes on Romania's Andrei Leustean.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 450 - DMG Boxing presents Night of Champions IV part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents DMG Boxing Night of Champions IV part 1 from The Fox Theater in Pomona, Califorinia. Starting off the night, Adan Gonzales out of Denver takes to the ring in a southpaw matchup with Dedrick Crocklem of Seattle with a 3-0 record. Also on this card, Samuel Isak takes on Chris Pacheco making his pro-debut. Watch as veteran boxer Vaughn Alexander returns to the DMG ring from St. Louis to take on unstoppable Ruben Cazales with a record of 12-0 and 11 KO's in a super middleweight battle.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 453 - DMG Boxing presents Night of Champions IV part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents DMG Boxing Night of Champions IV part 2 from The Fox Theater in Pomona, California. Starting off with a female bout, undefeated fighters Olympian Brianda Cruz and Susana Lopez step into the ring to fight for their perfect record. In the main event is another battle of the undefeated as David Romero takes on Pedro Valencia who is coming off of a three year hiatus.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 371 - KOK Best Of Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the Best of King of Kings part 2. In a boxing match Naglis Tamasevicius faces Juris Zundovskis. In a clash of the titans, heavyweight Martin Pacas is matched up against Turkey's Kadir Yildirim "The Terminator." Farshad Derekeh of the Netherlands and Latvian Reinis Porozovs take to the ring in a boxing bout and Beka Gabisonia faces Farruh Gafurov in the Mega Series.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 379 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 part 1 from London. Starting us off is a match between Jonny "The Zombie" Lawson and Ryan McCann and in a female bout, with both fighters making their BKB debut is Stephanie Dy versus Danni Lee. Also faceing off are Tyrone Eliffe and Richard Samuels and George Taylor and Andrei Nastac take to the ring to battle it out in a heavyweight bare knuckle match.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 380 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 part 2 from London. Watch as Kamil Sokolowski and Bri Morrow trade punches in a challenging matchup. Peter Hayes and Adam Grogan face off in the ring and Tony Barratt takes on Ryan Barrett. Also Ionel Levitchi of Romania and George Hillyard from London take to the ring.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 381 - Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 36 part 3 from London. Dan Gittens and Marcin "Psycho" Kosiak step into the ring while Eryk Majda faces Kevin Greenwood with the British heavyweight title on the line. Romanian Bogdan Suru takes on Welsh Ash Williams and in the main event, two BKB veterans Scott McHugh and Tony Lafferty head to the ring for the World Flywieght Title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 420 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 1 from Oradea, Romania. Starting in the heavyweight division, Remus Bortea is matched up against Vasile Corcodel whose three wins are all by KO. In a Superfight middleweight division bout, Darius Argyo takes on Andrei "The Bonecrusher" Varga in what's expected to be a fast paced bout. Also in this episode is Brazil versus Romania with two very experienced fighters, Rodrigo Mineiro takes on Claudio "The Prince" Badoi in an open weight division fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 421 - Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Dynamite Fighting Show 25 part 2 from Oradea, Romania. In the Super Middleweight division Steven Mendes from France takes on Romania's more experienced Andrei Ostrovanu with 42 wins (24 by KO). In an ISKA Cruiserweight World Title match, Vasileios Karagkiozis and Sebastian Lutanic vie for the belt in a Greece versus Romania bout. Also, in an open weight division Tolea Ciumac and Bogdan Nastase face off in a David versus Goliath match

programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championship 17 Rex Mundi from Rio De Janeiro. Up first Maruicio Otalora faces Eduardo Souza and Thiago Lima arm-bar specialist takes on the explosive Andre Borges. Also fighting tonight William Baraka and Jiolton Lutterbach and the winner of the Souza-Lima faces Ronys Torres in the finals of the four-man tournament.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 439 - KOK - Best of part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings from Lithuania. Walid Poyan faces Emilijus Kaganovicius in the Lightweight division and Ilir Bega steps into the ring with Ignas Pauliukevicius for a Heavyweight bout. Also in this episode Ivans Kozecenkovs and Deividas Zamba take to the ring for what's expected to be a highly intense battle. Marius Kutauskas, making his pro-debut is matched up against Samuelis Sorochovas. Watch as Likas Lapinskas takes on Arturs Skabarnieks in an MMA Heavyweight bout and in a Lightweight matchup, Morroco's Anas Hilboui takes on Afghanistan's Tamim Shariffi in a very evenly matched fight. Also, in a Lightweight bout, Christiano Silva faces off against the much more experienced Mindaugas Narauskas.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 360 - KOK 104 World Series Kaunas Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 104 World Series Kaunas, Lithuania part 1. Starting the night is a lightweight match between Tiago Mendes and Champion Mindaugas Narauskas. Nika Khelaidze takes on Vitoldas Jagelo in an MMA Bushido contest, Jussi Pirttikangas faces Erikas Golubovskis, Nicola Kisari, making his pro-debut, and Nauris Lukosiunas face off in a Romania versus Lithuania matchup. Also watch Bruno Borges from Portugal take on Lithuanian Samuelis Sorochovas.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 361 - KOK 104 World Series Kaunas Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 104 World Series Kaunas, Lithuania part 2. In this episode Soslan Gasiev faces former heavyweight champion Tomas Pakutinskas, up and comers Arnestas Naujokas and Gustas Dimsa faceoff in the ring, Poland's Jakub Kwasniewski faces charasmatic Vitas Karosas from Lithuania, experienced fighters Filip Rzadek and Ignas Barysas look to make their match fight of the night.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 362 - KOK 104 World Series Kaunas Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 104 World Series Kaunas, Lithuania part 3. First up Moldovanian Nicolai Garbuz faces Mantas Kondratavicius of Lithuania in an MMA Bushido bout and Sasa Polugic takes on Mantas Rimdeika for some heavyweight action. In the main event Simon Santana and Matas Pultarazinskas head to the ring for a featherweight bout with the World Championship up for grabs.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 432- Shamrock 361
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock FC 361 from Kansas City, Missouri. In the opening match, Ethan Hall steps into the cage with Bryson Osborne and Kylen Snider takes on Torry Moore in the welterweight division. Also on this card, Soy Migo and Misael Monarrez are set to take the challenge. In the main event undefeated Tyson Hicks faces Willie Henderson, making his pro-debut in a kickboxing bout.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 348 - CFC 13 Non Ducor, Duco
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Centurion Fighting Championship 13, Non Ducor Duco from Sao Paulo Brazil. This episode features a four man tournament. programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Bare Knuckle Boxing 27 part 1 from London. In the first match of the night Fabrico Martins faces Bruno Tavares and in the second match Leandro Rodrigues faces Antonio Monteiro. The two winners will move on to the main event.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 255 - KOK’84 World Series, Vilnius part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 1. In a battle between Lithuanian fighters, Zygimantas Kidikas making his pro debut goes up against his 2-0 opponent Ovidijus Pocius. Watch as Aleh Moshin (Belarus) faces Samuelis Sorochovas (Lithuania), Osvaladas Fedorovic takes on the less experienced Aurimas Krukauskas in a battle between Lithuanian fighters and Vladislav Shatunskui (Poland) battles against Gustas Dimsa (Lithuania). In addition Polish fighter Hubert Dylewski takes on Lithuanian Jan Naus in a very evenly matched fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 256 - KOK’84 World Series, Vilnius Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 2. In this episode, watch as Ukrainian Volodymyr Hynzhu takes on Lithuanian Raimondas Avlasevicius, Finn Larsen (Ireland) goes up against the more experienced Nauris Lukosiunas (Lithuania) and Oleskil Mykhailo 9-0 (Ukraine) faces Henrikas Viksraitis 43-7(Lithuania). In the main event Lithuanians Zygimantas Ramaska and Vitoldas Jagelo face one another in an MMA Bushido battle with at title on the line.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 257 - Shamrock FC 334
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock Fighting Championship out of the Ameristar Casino in St. Charles, MO. In this event Austin Miller faces Arvin Mills in the cage, Arnez Ferguson takes on Pat Vega in a kickboxing bout and in a female match, Livvy Pecher takes on Lora Campbell. Also Jason Gavril faces Isaac Dancy and Nico Alcaraz takes on Todd Madden in the middleweight division. In the Co-Main event Devin Anderson takes on Aushton Elleby Midkiff and in the main event Jeremiah Curtright with a 3 fight win streak takes on Zack Davis with a 4 fight win streak.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 258 - UFA Presents the Fighter's Only World MMA Awards XIII
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents the 13th annual Fighter's Only 2021 World MMA Awards from Worre Studios in Las Vegas, hosted by Chael Sonnen. Presentations by Dave Farra, Jessy Jess, Doggface208, Emily Whitmire, Cassie Scherbo, Jay Hieron, Dan Henderson, Kayla Harrison, Mackenzie Dern, and more.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 259 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 1. Young Estonian fighters Stanislav Teniugin and Siim Viljus battle under KOK Kickboxing rules. Aleh Moshin from Belarus takes on Karl Margus Haud out of Estonia and Edvinas Bubelis (Lithuania) faces Sergei Strinza (Estonia). Also, powerhouse Volodymyr Hynzju from Ukraine takes on Aleksey Larin from Estonia.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 260 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 2. Watch as the first ever KOK women's bantamweight world championship title is on the line. In some intense all-female matchups each fighter is vying to move on to the finals for a chance at the title. In the semi-finals Estonians Sigrid Kapanen and Astrid Johanna Grents fight to move on and Italian Ludovica Ciarpaglini faces Polish Ilona Woijda to see who will move on to the Grand Prix final match and have a chance at the title.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 261 - KOK 94 Tallinn Part 3
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents King of Kings 94 World Series from Tallinn, Estonia part 3. Watch as Canadian Mohammed Shushan faces Jevgeni "Zora XXL" Ravlusevits of Estonia and Dzmitry Varats (Belarus) takes on Ott Remmer (Estonia).

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 262 - Shamrock FC 335
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock 335 from Ameristar Casino St Charles. Watch as Pat Gordon takes on Adam Stone, Stanton Ketcherside faces Jerry Ing, Matt Tinker battles it out against James Yarbrough, Kevin Mueller faces Trevon Crawford and Tavae Lewis faces Josh Weston In the co-main event in a kickboxing bout, Ian Zarvos faces Cody Naucke and in the main event Josh Augustin returns to the cage after a long layoff to take on blackbelt Thomas Thatcher.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 263 - SFT 30 - Predador vs Manchinha
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents SFT 30 from Brazil. Denis Araujo with 6 KO's meets Jose Reborn Alexandre in the cage for a fierce MMA bout. In a compelling matchup, Paulo Pizzo takes on the much younger Fernando "ben 10" Lourenco and in the lightweight division #1 ranked Felipe Buakaw takes on #2 Marcio Velaminho. In the main event Wellington Predador faces Thiago Manchinha in an exciting matchup.

Watch as Pat Gordon takes on Adam Stone, Stanton Ketcherside faces Jerry Ing, Matt Tinker battles it out against James Yarbrough, Kevin Mueller faces Trevon Crawford and Tavae Lewis faces Josh Weston In the co-main event in a kickboxing bout, Ian Zarvos faces Cody Naucke and in the main event Josh Augustin returns to the cage after a long layoff to take on blackbelt Thomas Thatcher.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 263 - SFT 30 - Predador vs Manchinha
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents SFT 30 from Brazil. Denis Araujo with 6 KO's meets Jose Reborn Alexandre in the cage for a fierce MMA bout. In a compelling matchup, Paulo Pizzo takes on the much younger Fernando "ben 10" Lourenco and in the lightweight division #1 ranked Felipe Buakaw takes on #2 Marcio Velaminho. In the main event Wellington Predador faces Thiago Manchinha in an exciting matchup.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 255 - KOK’84 World Series, Vilnius part 1
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 1. In a battle between Lithuanian fighters, Zygimantas Kidikas making his pro debut goes up against his 2-0 opponent Ovidijus Pocius. Watch as Aleh Moshin (Belarus) faces Samuelis Sorochovas (Lithuania), Osvaladas Fedorovic takes on the less experienced Aurimas Krukauskas in a battle between Lithuanian fighters and Vladislav Shatunskui (Poland) battles against Gustas Dimsa (Lithuania). In addition Polish fighter Hubert Dylewski takes on Lithuanian Jan Naus in a very evenly matched fight.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 256 - KOK’84 World Series, Vilnius Part 2
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents KOK '84 World Series from Vilnius Lithuania part 2. In this episode, watch as Ukrainian Volodymyr Hynzhu takes on Lithuanian Raimondas Avlasevicius, Finn Larsen (Ireland) goes up against the more experienced Nauris Lukosiunas (Lithuania) and Oleskil Mykhailo 9-0 (Ukraine) faces Henrikas Viksraitis 43-7(Lithuania). In the main event Lithuanians Zygimantas Ramaska and Vitoldas Jagelo face one another in an MMA Bushido battle with at title on the line.

programme.title: United Fight Alliance - UFA 257 - Shamrock FC 334
programme.desc: United Fight Alliance presents Shamrock Fighting Championship out of the Ameristar Casino in St. Charles, MO. programme.title: Daddy

programme.title: Tapestry of Shadows
programme.desc: Reverend Vincent Purejoy and his wife Beverly witness a drive-by shooting that results in a child's death. Vincent decides to start his own neighborhood watch and suddenly finds himself at odds with friends and family.

programme.title: You Never Know
programme.desc: Immersed in a world filled with crime, drugs and betrayal, a group of friends have a tough time dealing with the daily pressures of life. With the support of one another, they come up with a plan to overcome their reality.

programme.title: Out with the Old
programme.desc: Recent graduate, Grace Jones, has just about had it with her lazy, long-term boyfriend, and she is ready for something new. Grace sets her sights on finding someone who can appreciate her while trying to land a dream.

programme.title: Dream Visions
programme.desc: An auspicious organization with a nefarious past remerges in a city full of "talent" for them to cultivate. The question for all involved is: Who would you sacrifice for everything you want?

programme.title: House of Children
programme.desc: Conversations at a Zimbabwean children's home.

programme.title: In Search of the Black Knight
programme.desc: In Search of the Black Knight is a relationship documentary that takes a humorous and thought-provoking look at the current state of black relationships in America. Director Tamarat Makonnen travels across the country to find answers.

programme.title: Abort
programme.desc: Staring at a crossroads, Monica is battling between making advancements within her career or the next steps in her relationship.

programme.title: Itâ€™ll Cost You
programme.desc: Fiona vows never to fall in love again. Now a millionaire, she uses the money to keep her current man in line until a side chick infiltrates. Fiona says the side chick can have him, but she must pay her back the money she spent on him or die.

programme.title: My Father's Keeper
programme.desc: Who are the typical keepers of a father? Sons. Not so in this film, where five kick-butt sisters bring the heat to protect their father from a Jamaican crime family.

programme.title: My Girl Story
programme.desc: The story of two African-American girls' journeys from Detroit. The documentary highlights the struggles and beauty of being an African American girl in today's age.

programme.title: Tears of Steel
programme.desc: In an apocalyptic future, a group of soldiers and scientists takes refuge in Amsterdam to try to stop an army of robots that threatens the planet.

programme.title: Messy
programme.desc: A crime drama about a reckless drug dealer and his unfaithful girlfriend.

programme.title: Imperfect Getaway
programme.desc: A group of friends is on a getaway. Nate & London are well off, and Andrew & Jordan are struggling financially due to Jordanâ€™s previous addiction. Jordan becomes suspicious of Nateâ€™s perfect image. Nate may be hiding a secret life, Jordan investigates.

programme.title: The Musical Adventures of Afro Banzai
programme.desc: A group of culturally diverse teens each receive an invitation to a mystical music school where they take on various challenges to help unlock their hidden musical potential.

programme.title: Urge
programme.desc: A newlywed husband must conquer the urge to watch porn, which is impacting his marriage and all of his close relationships.

programme.title: The System: America's Epidemic

programme.desc: A successful woman architect changes careers to become a nurse and help the effort during World War II. It was based on the novel One Pair of Feet by Monica Dickens. A tribute to the important work of female nurses during WWII.

programme.title: Letter of Introduction
programme.desc: An aging actor, receiving a letter from his long-lost son, seizes the chance to reconnect. The reunion becomes a comical, heartwarming adventure as the duo navigate the challenges of Broadway together.

programme.title: The Italian
programme.desc: An immigrant leaves his sweetheart in Italy to find a better life across the sea in the grimy slums of New York. They are eventually reunited and marry. But life in New York is hard, and tragedy tarnishes their dream of a better life in the new world.

programme.title: Sin Takes a Holiday
programme.desc: A plain secretary works for a womanizing divorce lawyer who only dates married women. To avoid dealing with the marital pursuits of his potential romances, he offers her financial support if she marries him, but in name only.

programme.desc: Haunted by a prank gone fatally wrong, five friends reunite to heal. But not all can forget, and it's clear that someone or something is out for revenge.

programme.desc: Detective's Joey Moretti and Patricia Stevens are trying to track down a serial killer that preys on young attractive women, leaving only cryptic messages carved into their flesh as clues! Joey struggles to keep himself together as the investigation leads him closer and closer to the deranged killer!

programme.title: The Faith Community
programme.desc: A group of religious students drive into the remote wilderness to spend time with a religious sect and strengthen their bond with God. The three unsuspecting students film everything to document their experience but soon find themselves in the dark.

programme.title: A Gun for Jennifer
programme.desc: A woman comes to New York City from Ohio to escape an abusive husband and gets entangled with murderous female vigilantes who prey on abusive men.

programme.title: Cut Her Out
programme.desc: Darcy can't purge her mind of the animalistic abuse she suffered as a child at the hands of her mother. Darcy's therapist Ryan discovers that her family homestead has been abandoned.

programme.title: Death Mask
programme.desc: Wilbur works in an old carnival and shows some gruesome things to the puplic. He covered his face because he had a sadistic father who burned his face. Everybody makes jokes about his scars and when the new boss fired him, he go to an old swamp-witch who gives him a peace of wood from a hanging tree and Wilbur makes a mask from this piece of wood and put all his anger in this mask. When he puts the mask on, everybody who looks on this mask commits suicide. He has created the Death-Mask.

programme.title: Hunting Season
programme.desc: Tom Sizemore and Eric Roberts in this tense thriller about two FBI agents who track down a missing person's case which leads them to a group of stock brokers who hunt people for sport.

programme.title: Temptation
programme.desc: A beautiful, young woman out on the town with friends is saved from the clutches of a serial rapist by an ancient but gorgeous vampire, but at what cost?

programme.title: The Minx

programme.title: Exorcism in Utero

programme.title: False River
programme.desc: Three lunatics escape from a mental institution only to find the real world is crazier than they ever were.

programme.title: Sharp Teeth

programme.title: American Terror Story

programme.title: Titans of Business
programme.desc: There have been many stories and documentaries on the Bill Gates’, Steve Jobs’ and Henry Fords’ of the world. What about the thousands of other business people, that had a better idea or way to make life better, cheaper, and faster? People who started out from meager beginnings or limited education, to become very wealthy! Many of these people are among us and act no differently than we do, but they have a success story to tell and tricks of success to share. These are the people profiled in “Titans of Business”.

programme.title: Sailing To Tokyo - Episode 4
programme.desc: In this month's episode we move to the western edge of Europe and the second largest city of Portugal, Porto. Located alongside the stunning Douro River, Porto is home ot the 2019 Laser Senior European Championships and Open European Trophy with all the top names of the class. Also, new ambitious senior sailors are on their way to the titles.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 2 - Reality
programme.desc: Now closing in on Mexico and having spent nearly a month at sea, the crew are facing some realities they didn’t expect. It’s cold, it’s wet, and its nothing like what they were hoping. Adding to the chaos, Barry is emotionally lost and opens up about what he left behind to go on this trip. As the crew pokes around Catalina Island and down into Mexico a reckoning with what the trip is and what they wanted it to be is on the horizon and with it a new reality of life.

programme.title: Sailing Deejay - Episode 1
programme.desc: Our DJ adventure is about to begin! Come with us as we pack our bags and leave for sunny Ibiza in Spain. After dropping our bags we are saying hi to David Guetta before trying out our skills as DJs and finding out how Ibiza's nightlife will surprise us. Join us!

programme.title: Sailing Deejay - Episode 2
programme.desc: Sailing Deejay continues its journey in Ibiza and the nearing islands to the rhythm of the night! Sam and Max are getting on more adventures, and while they sail during the day they party and DJ during the night! When will they get a chance to sleep and rest a bit? Let's get the party started, on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.8 - LOŠINJ - CRES
European Dragon Championship
programme.desc: The European Dragon Championship promises to amaze spectators with the continent’s top dragon sailors racing in one of the world’s most beautiful sailing arenas, the Italian Riviera.

programme.title: Rolex Spirit Of Yachting - Ep.2 - Rolex TP52 World Championship
International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom World Cup Markkleeberg
programme.desc: Markkleeberg, in Germany, is home to the Pleisse River that runs through the city. Known for merging several towns over the years, it now combines the best athletes who compete in the Slalom World Cup.Watch the most extreme canoe slalom that will decide the world champion in this unique 2021 Markkleeberg competition.

programme.title: International Canoe Federation World Cup - Slalom World Cup Prague
programme.desc: Prague hosts the 2021 Slalom World Cup, and the top class athletes are getting ready for a weekend full of action. They will have to pass through a combination of upstream and downstream gates in the fastest time possible, however the competition will prove to be hard as only the best will be in this event.Watch the Slalom World Cup competition that is taking place in Prague.

programme.title: Facing Waves - Ep7 - Kayaking Northern Ireland
programme.desc: Ken Whiting kayaks along Northern Ireland\'s Giant\'s Causeway Coast near Derry and Strangford Lough outside Belfast.

programme.title: Inside Vienna - Imperial City Meets Nautical Sports
programme.desc: Welcome to Vienna!Austria’s capital, lying by the Danube River and known for its artistic and intellectual legacy shaped by residents as Mozart, Beethoven or Sigmund Freud amongst others. Vienna is a city known for its tradition, but has also become the scene for modern nautical sports that are shifting the world of water sports.From meeting the Austrian Olympic rowing team to freestyle kayaking and a rendezvous with the local Gondola Club, host Lucia Metzbauer is on a quest to discover the nautical sports and athletes of Vienna. She is set for a challenge as she sails across all the different sport options in the city.Become part of the Vienna scenery and discover the water sports this city has to offer from the side of Lucia Metzbauer, on Inside Vienna – Imperial City Meets Nautical Sports.

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32 - Episode 1
programme.desc: The GC32 Racing Tour is back! The World Sailing foiling catamaran circuit has returned as the world recovers from COVID, and both teams and organizers have been keen to return to racing onboard their state-of-the-art flying catamarans. After 18 months of no racing and cancelled events, the anticipation going into the first event in Lagos, Portugal is huge!After a highly competitive, spectacular 2019 season the GC32 foiling cats are back on the racecourse. In 2021, the ultra-high performance one-design catamarans will visit 3 top venues for 4 events, each location selected specially to provide conditions ideal for the nimble GC32s to fly across the water at 30+ knot speeds.So, let’s travel to Lagos, in southern Portugal's Algarve region to witness the first GC32 Racing Tour event for 2021, Lagos Cup 1.

programme.title: P1 USA UIM Class 1 - Episode 6 Roar Offshore on Fort Myers, FL
programme.desc: The P1 welcomes the 2021 Roar Offshore Fort Myers Grand Prix, the final round of the APBA Offshore National Championship. Teams are making their final adjustments to their boats ahead of this weekend's national championship decider. The 5-mile course situated off Fort Myers Beach will see boats passing the shoreline and local Pier at over 130mph. Are you ready for the action? Watch the best moments of the competition, on Nautical Channel!

programme.title: Speed Catamarans GC32 - Episode 2
programme.desc: Welcome to the second event of the 2021 GC32 Racing Tour. You are about to see all of the foiling action from Lagos on Portugal's beautiful Algarve! As usual, on the GC32 Racing Tour each venue has been selected to provide the best conditions for the nimble GC32s to fly at 30+ knots speeds. But - spoiler alert... in this episode you'll see them racing at almost 40 knots! Lagos is once more in the center of the sailing universe with the GC32 Lagos Cup 2. Appropriately coinciding with the Olympic Games, the event included some of the sailing's leading names, including several multiple Olympic medallists.

programme.title: H2O Racing: Aquabike World Championship - Preview
P1 USA AquaX - Episode 6 Review
programme.desc: The AquaX 2021 USA Championship season might be over, but we are still thrilled with the adrenaline lived these past months. It is time we look back at the most breath-taking moments of the championship, going from Daytona up to St Pete. Are you joining us? Relive the best moments of the 2021 AquaX USA Championship.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 2 - Reality
programme.desc: Now closing in on Mexico and having spent nearly a month at sea, the crew are facing some realities they didn’t expect. It’s cold, it’s wet, and its nothing like what they were hoping. Adding to the chaos, Barry is emotionally lost and opens up about what he left behind to go on this trip. As the crew pokes around Catalina Island and down into Mexico a reckoning with what the trip is and what they wanted it to be is on the horizon and with it a new reality of life.

programme.title: Inside Vienna - Imperial City Meets Nautical Sports
programme.desc: Welcome to Vienna!Austria’s capital, lying by the Danube River and known for its artistic and intellectual legacy shaped by residents as Mozart, Beethoven or Sigmund Freud amongst others. Vienna is a city known for its tradition, but has also become the scene for modern nautical sports that are shifting the world of water sports.From meeting the Austrian Olympic rowing team to freestyle kayaking and a rendezvous with the local Gondola Club, host Lucia Metzbauer is on a quest to discover the nautical sports and athletes of Vienna. She is set for a challenge as she sails across all the different sport options in the city.Become part of the Vienna scenery and discover the water sports this city has to offer from the side of Lucia Metzbauer, on Inside Vienna – Imperial City Meets Nautical Sports.

Surf Series: South Africa - Episode 1
programme.desc: South Africa has some of the best and most consistent surf breaks in the world but the qualifying series, for years, lacked events there. This year competitive surfing is back in South Africa and the season returned with a bang, with five QS Events ranging from 1 star, to 3 star, before culminating at the 6 star Ballito Pro. Let's reflect on the highlights of 2017.

programme.title: Anchored in Paradise - Ep.9 - OPATIJA - IČIĆI - MOSĆENIČKA DRAGA
Dis.Traction
programme.desc: The two-time world wave sailing champion Marcilio Browne, originally from Brazil, has decided to make the Hawaiian island of Maui his permanent home to pursue his passion. Dis.Traction follows Marcilio during his first training sessions leading into to the decisive season’s final contest where the greatest windsurfers compete for the ultimate prize.Following the end of contest season, Marcilio and fellow wave sailing champion Morgan Noireaux take to the mountains, or rather to the volcano for some alternative action. As the island is exposed to heavy ground swells from many directions, Marcilio and his friends are always looking for ideal spots to practice.Dis.Traction is a rollercoaster ride of action and an authentic insight into the perspective of a seasoned professional windsurfer. Shot on location it features the breathtaking beauty of the Hawaiian Island of Maui and showcases appearances of some of the sport’s greatest athletes.

programme.title: Sailing To Tokyo - Episode 5
programme.desc: This time we stay in Europe but find ourselves in Russia's most western and exquisite city: St. Petersburg. We are following the 2019 RS:X Youth World Championship, and this event was hosted by the St. Petersburg Regional Sports, non-governmental Organization: Yacht Club of St. Petersburg. We stay for the opening ceremony before flying to China for the Nimble Cup Asian Windsurfing Championship 2019. To round off the trip in Olympic classes, join us as we fet off to Italy's San Remo for the 470 European Championships.

programme.title: Reaching Reality - Episode 3 - Freedom
programme.desc: Deeper south into the Baja Peninsula, the weather has calm and sunny days are more common. As we open the episode with the boat breaking free from being trapped by an anchor locked in the reef, there is a new sense of freedom. On the horizon are rare and never-before seen islands with beached seals, isolated lighthouse keepers, and massive salt mines. As they discover the new and uncharted, word comes in that surf is coming and now the race is on to get the best location to capture the incoming waves.

programme.title: Formula Kite European Championships - Ep.1 - URLA
VOR Identity
programme.desc: The Volvo Ocean Race visits 10 cities around the world making it the ultimate test for sailors around the world. Often described as the longest and toughest professional sporting event in the world, it is one of the sport’s Big Three events, alongside the Olympic Games and America’s Cup.However, to truly understand the race, it is better to think about the athletes who take part of it. Meet the teams and the superstars in Alicante on the eve of their quest to the Volvo Ocean Race. They share the same obsession for the sea, and many of them have fully dedicated themselves for years, even decades trying to win.Map the racecourse, get the latest intel on the boats and the tech and above all, find out what really moves the action of heroes from modern day offshore sailing. Watch it now, on Nautical Channel and become part of this sailing frenzy.

programme.title: VOR Supremacy
programme.desc: The Volvo Ocean Race sails around 10 cities from all over the world, making it the ultimate test for sailors. Often described as the longest and toughest professional sporting event in the world, it is one of the sport’s big three events, alongside the Olympic Games and America’s Cup.The cannon blast in Alicante sends off the fleet, and once again shakes the sailing world. The veterans finally get their memory back while for the rookies it feels like mission impossible. They share the same obsession for the sea, and many of them have fully dedicated themselves for years, even decades trying to win it.The 2017-18 edition of the Volvo Ocean Race sets sail around the globe. The challenge is full on, and now they are all going rogue.

programme.title: Longines Global Champions Tour - Ep7 - Stockholm
The Dutch Masters 2021 Highlights
programme.desc: As the largest indoor show in the Netherlands, The Dutch Masters (Indoor Brabant Horse Show) has already stood for top-class equestrian sport for half a century. Together with the CHI Genève, CSIO Spruce Meadows Masters and the CHIO Aachen, the Dutch Masters is one of the four top events of the respected Rolex Grand Slam. The best riders in the world meet up every year in March in a bid to ride to victory in the legendary Brabanthallen. The first World Cup Final of showjumping was staged in this venue for the first time in 1994, and since prestigious competitions and more finals have taken place in one of the four pillars of showjumping and dressage. Intense competitions meet exquisite entertainment amid the unique atmosphere of the Dutch Masters. You can now watch the highlights of the competition on Horse TV.
